clean_body: [] This time a year ago, Donald Trump promised Americans $2,000 rebate checks, and that all of our bills would be cut in half. He promised that DOGE would cut trillions of dollars of waste from the federal budget and that there would be no new wars. Now look where we are. Higher grocery and gas prices, way higher housing costs, spiking energy bills, and out-of-reach health care costs. A vulnerable economy with higher unemployment. And a new war in Iran without a plan or end in sight. And yet, Donald Trump brags about how proud he is of this economy. That’s a stunning thing to think, let alone say out loud! Might as well be Marie Antoinette declaring, let them eat cake . This economy may be working just fine for the 1% or the billionaires but it is not working for everyday people. When I travel across Virginia and talk to people, no one tells me the economy is “roaring.” They want their leaders to be focused on helping them afford their lives, not distracted by vanity projects, personal grudges, and rewriting history. Trump can keep pretending everything is great, but the rest of us know better. Trump promised to lower costs on Day One, but his reckless economic policies have driven prices up for everyone. And new data shows that American households paid an average of $1,000 more over the past year thanks to Trump’s idiotic and pointless tariffs. I’ve been battling Trump’s tariff idiocy in the Senate since he got back into office, and I’m proud that both Congress and the Supreme Court have taken a stand and rolled back some of his worst tariff policies. But Trump has shown he’s not done gaslighting hardworking Americans and enriching himself and his buddies, so I’m continuing to fight to give families some actual relief. I need your voice in this fight — will you add your name today to stand with me against Trump’s failed economic policies and reckless tariffs? name: Patrick J. Murphy
subject: Energy Prices Are Worse As a Result of the Iran War
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/PJM_Logo.png]
As the U.S. War in Iran enters its third week, the impact on energy prices has become impossible to ignore. The war has effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz, leading to the biggest oil supply disruption in history. [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/09/the-us-iran-war-is-the-biggest-oil-supply-disruption-in-history.html]
Oil was around $67/barrel [https://time.com/article/2026/03/17/what-is-the-strait-of-hormuz-global-trade-oil-flow-iran-war/] before the U.S. and Israel launched their first strikes on February 28. Nearly three weeks later, they’re regularly above $100. Brent crude hit $119 [https://apnews.com/article/stocks-markets-oil-iran-trump-1abeddf7c4bf19d1dc96b3f23c1de402] earlier this week.
According to AAA, the national average for a gallon of regular gasoline jumped over $3.84 on Wednesday, up from $2.98 consumers were paying before the U.S. launched the war on Feb. 28. Gas prices hadn’t been this expensive since September 2023.
But the price spike is only part of the story. The war has moved beyond the Strait of Hormuz blockade into something more permanent: the destruction of the infrastructure that produces the energy. Israel struck the Iranian portion of South Pars [https://www.cnn.com/2026/03/19/middleeast/iran-qatar-south-pars-gas-field-explainer-intl] , the world's largest natural gas field. Iran responded by hitting the Qatari side [https://www.cfr.org/articles/iran-war-escalates-on-energy-front] of the same reservoir.
Kuwait [https://link.cfr.org/click/44795236.68155/aHR0cHM6Ly9hcG5ld3MuY29tL2xpdmUvaXJhbi13YXItaXNyYWVsLXRydW1wLTAzLTE5LTIwMjY_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kYWlseWJyaWVmJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PTIwMjYwMzE5IzAwMDAwMTlkLTA1MTItZDcwNi1hM2RmLTU1Zjc5OTllMDAwMA/6973cdfdf0572e51140d7d0aB46095b7b] and Saudi Arabia [https://link.cfr.org/click/44795236.68155/aHR0cHM6Ly9hcG5ld3MuY29tL2xpdmUvaXJhbi13YXItaXNyYWVsLXRydW1wLTAzLTE5LTIwMjY_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kYWlseWJyaWVmJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PTIwMjYwMzE5IzAwMDAwMTlkLTA1MzUtZDgxMy1hZmJkLTRmZmQ3MWMyMDAwMA/6973cdfdf0572e51140d7d0aB229b7dbe] also reported drone strikes on their energy facilities. Saudi Arabia is now threatening [https://link.cfr.org/click/44795236.68155/aHR0cHM6Ly93d3cucmV1dGVycy5jb20vd29ybGQvbWlkZGxlLWVhc3Qvcml5YWRoLXJlc2lkZW50cy1yZWNlaXZlLXBob25lLWFsZXJ0cy1maXJzdC10aW1lLXdhcm5pbmctaG9zdGlsZS10aHJlYXQtMjAyNi0wMy0xOC8_dXRtX3NvdXJjZT1kYWlseWJyaWVmJnV0bV9jb250ZW50PTIwMjYwMzE5/6973cdfdf0572e51140d7d0aB2cdcc5f7] military retaliation. These are multibillion-dollar installations that take years to build. Even if the strait reopens tomorrow, the damage doesn't reverse for a while.
On top of this, markets are now pricing in the possibility that the Fed won't cut rates this year [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/18/odds-of-a-fed-rate-hike-by-june-are-now-higher-than-chances-for-rate-cut.html] . Fed Chair Jerome Powell [https://www.foxbusiness.com/politics/feds-powell-says-its-too-soon-know-iran-wars-impact-economy] said it’s “too soon to know” the economic impact of this war. The European Central Bank [https://www.politico.eu/article/eu-ecb-doom-warning-iran-war-wages-on/] warned this week that a prolonged disruption to the energy supply would mean inflation above and growth below their baseline projections. In other words: stagflation.
Meanwhile, Trump has asked his allies (with no success) to send warships into a strait full of naval mines and anti-ship missiles to reopen it. Most have said no. Germany, Italy, and Japan have already ruled out sending naval vessels [https://www.axios.com/2026/03/17/strait-hormuz-iran-blockade-oil-trump-coalition] . The EU's foreign policy chief said "This is not Europe's war."
French President Emmanuel Macron [https://thehill.com/homenews/5788332-france-declines-strait-of-hormuz-operation/] has also ruled out helping Trump seize control of the Strait, saying “France will never take part in operations to open or liberate the Strait of Hormuz.”
The U.S. deployment to secure the Strait would require roughly 5,000 troops [https://www.yahoo.com/news/articles/trump-reportedly-orders-5-000-194112064.html] —a combination of U.S. Army SOF, Tier 1 units, and U.S. Marines from the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit, currently on their way to the region.
The following charts from Scott Galloway’s Substack [https://substack.com/@profgalloway/p-191066432] illustrate the economic impact of the war.
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/Affected%20Countries.png]
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/NGP/NGP25/1/106220/images/Estimated%20sources.png]
Appreciate you reading our newsletter. You can find me on CNN tonight at 7pm discussing the Iran War and its implications on our economy. This week I also spoke with Market Watch [https://www.marketwatch.com/video/mwi-clips/how-the-energy-crisis-could-affect-the-fed-policy-decisions/3D180A1F-3981-4F25-9B6A-2228EFB606DD.html?gaa_at=eafs&gaa_n=AWEtsqeV6FePxLFozlAxoFufFHHX88Pvgs048GcdBoGz8xvmZbnBxhkWOQmtyy-6Of8%3D&gaa_ts=69bc4a03&gaa_sig=LGmObBVxj0Q5qVyqpAmH0BoJe2thkLlQpm-jArL-r1OQ0ZqkjR7Sdv2FRdfHXqXCk-s6DFS-3qs_DBoeavJ-5g%3D%3D] and CNBC [https://www.cnbc.com/2026/03/11/iran-war-hyperscalers-huge-middle-east-ai-data-center-plans.html] . clean_body: [] As the U.S. War in Iran enters its third week, the impact on energy prices has become impossible to ignore. The war has effectively closed the Strait of Hormuz, leading to the biggest oil supply disruption in history. [] Oil was around $67/barrel [] before the U.S. and Israel launched their first strikes on February 28. Nearly three weeks later, they’re regularly above $100. Brent crude hit $119 [] earlier this week. According to AAA, the national average for a gallon of regular gasoline jumped over $3.84 on Wednesday, up from $2.98 consumers were paying before the U.S. launched the war on Feb. 28. Gas prices hadn’t been this expensive since September 2023. But the price spike is only part of the story. The war has moved beyond the Strait of Hormuz blockade into something more permanent: the destruction of the infrastructure that produces the energy. Israel struck the Iranian portion of South Pars [] , the world's largest natural gas field. Iran responded by hitting the Qatari side [] of the same reservoir. Kuwait [] and Saudi Arabia [] also reported drone strikes on their energy facilities. Saudi Arabia is now threatening [] military retaliation. These are multibillion-dollar installations that take years to build. Even if the strait reopens tomorrow, the damage doesn't reverse for a while. On top of this, markets are now pricing in the possibility that the Fed won't cut rates this year [] . Fed Chair Jerome Powell [] said it’s “too soon to know” the economic impact of this war. The European Central Bank [] warned this week that a prolonged disruption to the energy supply would mean inflation above and growth below their baseline projections. In other words: stagflation. Meanwhile, Trump has asked his allies (with no success) to send warships into a strait full of naval mines and anti-ship missiles to reopen it. Most have said no. Germany, Italy, and Japan have already ruled out sending naval vessels [] . The EU's foreign policy chief said "This is not Europe's war." French President Emmanuel Macron [] has also ruled out helping Trump seize control of the Strait, saying “France will never take part in operations to open or liberate the Strait of Hormuz.” The U.S. deployment to secure the Strait would require roughly 5,000 troops [] —a combination of U.S. Army SOF, Tier 1 units, and U.S. Marines from the 31st Marine Expeditionary Unit, currently on their way to the region. The following charts from Scott Galloway’s Substack [] illustrate the economic impact of the war. [] [] Appreciate you reading our newsletter. You can find me on CNN tonight at 7pm discussing the Iran War and its implications on our economy. This week I also spoke with Market Watch [] and CNBC [] . Please check us out on Instagram [=] and subscribe to my Substack [=] for our weekly geopolitical and business analysis. In this episode of The Kathy Barnette Show, we break down what's happening inside the Republican Party--and why the SAVE Act, a bill requiring proof of citizenship for federal voter registration, may face resistance from within.

Is this political dysfunction... or something more deliberate?

Kathy walks through:

1\. What the SAVE Act actually does (and why it matters)

2\. Why passing it should be straightforward under Republican control

3\. The internal resistance building inside the GOP

4\. Whether this is weakness, strategy, or something else entirely

This is bigger than one bill. It's about whether those in power are willing to act--and what happens when they don't.

body:
Let me tell you why I am running

| [|
---](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/Re6Ud5GiUilda7eppY0u-Q~~/AAUS1hA~/m4rgEHx4JiFgZwRU88Zyir-DaBHUPTccs7HFixSmUqKXh63KMsYCm9xNpx103VdTu7KWRxAFagCZ1nGZv4xS2463ByI3GTD0NRXP5WB3ELZexw9Km4DMx5Kwsp-486cN)
| | A few days ago, a man pulled me aside at a house party after my talk and the Q&A. He admitted, “I came into this room a pessimist. I’m leaving thinking you may be one of the few people who could beat Tim Burchett." I’m running to flip a congressional seat that hasn’t changed party hands since 1867. That's no small feat, and you deserve to know a little bit about me – and why I think winning this race is possible.

Y’all might already know that I’m a scientist (I have a PhD in Civil Engineering), and a small business owner (I own KnoxFill in South Knox), and that I spent a year working inside Congress as a Science Policy Fellow. Some things you might not know: ➡️ I grew up on a horse farm as the youngest of four daughters in a staunchly Republican family (I’m sure there are pictures of me at Bush Cheney rallies as a kid). ➡️ I’ve had a lot of jobs: nanny, magazine editor, farmhand, server, Spanish teacher, trip leader, research and teaching assistant, and business owner. I know what it’s like to worry about making payroll – and wonder why the amount on your check is so much lower than you thought it would be after working so hard at an hourly, tipped job. ➡️ My husband Max and I met in Knoxville while he was getting his PhD at UT in Energy Sciences. He recently became a U.S. citizen. I’m so proud of him and grateful he’s a citizen of the country we both love so much. **So why do I actually think we can win this?** **_We are building a movement to meet this moment._** When we host events, it's not just engaged, establishment Democrats showing up. It's Independents, former Republicans, young people, and people who've felt politically lost or politically hopeless for years.

We're building this campaign from the ground up. Hiring locally, growing political power and infrastructure here instead of sending all of our money to out-of-state consultants, creating the kind of community infrastructure that actually lasts beyond Election Day. As of this week, we have 500+ volunteers [(join us!)](https://go.sparkpostmail1.com/f/a/4eCwTUs8m4sh8u9kfqUhwQ~~/AAUS1hA~/yFqVbTFgtlUtJaXDyZW9oPqyRNhKbblMqOUQdTR24wpa811B8O1AbmiG_4tOu30HjASEZPW6tHt4OM2hegGpDwNU8_9htnmdG9MrpH8gorwFibkztolpkj50X3enevU-SJeUC1dMd3ySzFSFkloN49if3eJ1lq5_q70SCrkc8w1V3MpGlKLxyNoFkE-rR5H6PLb0pc-p3MOz-6sRI5MVUw~~) ready to knock doors, make phone calls, hold events, and flip this district.

I know the odds we're up against. But TN-02 deserves a representative who will never sell this district out for a handshake and a photo op.

We can do this. **But only with you.
**

body:
[ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

The Senate has kicked off a marathon debate on the SAVE Act – Trump's
latest scheme to gut our voting rights and "guarantee the midterms" for
Republicans.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36219?source=email-20260320&t=1011&akid=10417%2E5885482%2EhDXWwr ]Headline: Senate votes to take up Trump's voting bill to 'guarantee the
midterms'

Trump isn’t even bothering to hide it – the WHOLE point is to rig our
elections by putting up walls between millions of Americans and the ballot
box. Now his MAGA allies in Congress are trying to force this bill
through, even calling for an end to the filibuster to do it.

We can’t let Trump's plan succeed. There isn’t enough support in the
Senate right now to pass it, but Republicans are hoping that days – or
even WEEKS – of forced debate could change that, which is why we all need
to pile on the pressure RIGHT NOW.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36219?source=email-20260320&t=1012&akid=10417%2E5885482%2EhDXWwr ]Will you tell your Senators: VOTE NO on the SAVE Act NOW?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36219?source=email-20260320&t=1013&akid=10417%2E5885482%2EhDXWwr ]ADD YOUR NAME

If passed, the Save Act would force one of the biggest changes to voter
rights since the Voting Rights Act. Tens of MILLIONS of voters could be
disenfranchised.

Every American would need to present citizenship documents just to
register to vote – and a photo ID every time they cast a ballot. But 21
million Americans don’t have access to their citizenship documents and
millions more don’t have a government issued ID. And the Save Act could
impact millions more married women or others whose birth certificates
don’t match their current legal names because it will not allow proof of
name change or a marriage certificate as acceptable proof of identity.

This bill isn’t about election security. Trump’s made it clear it’s about
rigging the midterms so Republicans can’t lose. And now he’s strong-arming
the Senate to force it through – vowing to not sign a SINGLE other piece
of legislation until he gets his way, even if it means grinding our
government to a halt.

To bow to Trump, Republicans could force debate on the bill to last for
days or even weeks. Which means we have to keep up the pressure to stop
any of our representatives from caving to Trump’s pressure.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/36219?source=email-20260320&t=1014&akid=10417%2E5885482%2EhDXWwr ]Don’t wait. Tell your Senators: Don’t bow to Trump. Vote no on the SAVE
Act and protect our right to vote!

| | Dear Friend,
This past weekend I made it clear that I fully stand behind President Trump and his America First agenda. But right now that movement is under threat.
**While The SAVE America Act should be a bipartisan issue, somehow it’s not.**

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

Patriot,

Maybe you saw recently that a gunman opened fire outside a crowded bar in Austin, Texas, killing 3 innocent Americans.

Police officers responded in 57 seconds, running into the danger. They swiftly took down the gunman, saving countless lives.

Those officers should be commended for their heroic efforts in the face of danger and tragedy.

But instead, the radical District Attorney in Austin nearly put those officers before a grand jury until public outrage made him back off.

Why? Because the police shot the gunman.

And DA Jose Garza – who has made a career out of bringing bogus charges against cops – requires all officer-involved shootings to go before a grand jury.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D
If you agree that even considering murder charges against these heroes is beyond outrageous, I urgently need your help today.

My name is Jason Johnson and I am the President of the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

For over 30 years, LELDF has helped wrongly accused officers clear their names and get their lives back. We have a long record of success – getting charges dropped, winning at trial, and when all else fails, securing presidential pardons.

And right now we’re defending another Austin Police Officer who is fighting for his life.

Officer Chance Bretches is a decorated police officer. A loving husband. An amazing father.

He volunteers his time back in the community he swore an oath to protect.

Chance is everything woke leftists hate – so, Garza has launched not one but TWO WITCH-HUNTS to put Chance behind bars for life:

1. In 2019, before Garza was in office, Chance was dispatched to arrest a known drug trafficker. The trafficker resisted arrest forcing Chance to use physical force to handcuff him. He was cleared by SIX different internal investigations. But upon taking office in 2021, Garza charged Chance with aggravated assault. He faces life in prison.
2. In May 2020 during the George Floyd riots, Chance was assigned to perform crowd control and issued a non-lethal beanbag launcher. When a rioter began throwing rocks at officers, Chance discharged his beanbag launcher. One of the beanbags injured another rioter’s hand – and Garza once again charged Chance with aggravated assault. He faces life in prison in this case, too.

Multiple investigations prove Chance followed his training and department protocols to a tee.

But Garza won’t back down. He wants Chance to go to prison for the rest of his life.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D
That’s why I’m urgently turning to pro-police patriots like you to help Chance fight back.

You see, Chance is scheduled to go on trial in the beanbag case in less than 90 days which makes your support today critical.

This trial will cost approximately $150,000 – and that’s just the first trial. The date is still pending for the other. Meanwhile, LELDF currently supports more than a dozen other officers.

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D
Can I count on you to pitch in just $25, $50, or $100 to save this hero?

I don’t have to tell you what happens to police officers in prison...they're targeted by violent criminals.

This political witch-hunt against a good cop – an outstanding man – is a slap in the face to every American who respects the rule of law.

DA Garza showed us his true colors when he considered murder charges against the officer who stopped an active gunman from taking more lives in a crowded bar.

Now it’s time to stop him – and a send a message to all progressive prosecutors – before he ruins another good officer’s life.

Thank you for standing with Officer Chance Bretches and all the wrongly accused officers LELDF supports.

Gratefully,

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D

Jason C. Johnson

President, Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund

P.S. I wish I could say what’s happening to Officer Chance Bretches is unheard of – but the truth is that LELDF is supporting more than a dozen other wrongly accused officers right now. And we expect at least 10 of those cases to go to trial this year.
https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D
So, please make your best possible gift to allow LELDF to support Chance and all the other officers relying on us. Thank you again for your support!

https://click.parlermailer.com/?%3D%3D
STAND WITH CHANCE

More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we're defending, please visit www.leldf.org. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!

MAGA’s full court press on election laws and redistricting is an existential fight. All that matters is what we do to respond, push back, and fight for every single advantage we can get.

Peter,
Donald Trump has been on the warpath against mail-in voting for years.
And now he and his MAGA allies are on the cusp of a victory that would make voting by mail substantially harder for millions of voters in 30 states.
The case is Watson v. Republican National Committee. At issue is whether ballots delivered by mail must arrive and be received on Election Day or whether states can accept mail-in ballots that are postmarked on Election Day and which arrive within a certain grace period after Election Day.
The Supreme Court is scheduled to hear arguments on Monday. A ruling for MAGA would imperil thousands of military and overseas ballots and invalidate reasonable laws in 30 states and the District of Columbia that allow a grace period for receiving mail-in ballots:

---
| [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0011EBh1mqojgkoc93wmQEHeoc_eDdCn8HYSOoEtlafsHgWHXoGPkXRKGy-FZP5P_tK1gQEXLszvgbCyqm-vZNbo64b8OX1QnBjCWHQyXuX3-aSLHB8B_EGPDM2tkzV_KlJYZO1rGQcUIr5zSsT0QG8XKrTBBBDqfTEjNcbt8GbJO0dwk5vm92PLTNGj923PyGQ7OMv56HL3AMRcsBKLfHiSe7PUBmj05V_&c=s2vKFwqTwSxdKGr1sp6yavspOHmZFOXys9d9djAbfEkfpyLN5-d4Bg==&ch=yLpU07StGRNCIRCA8kGfjgJ50y-YMde5umJ3VIiSwFtZVe2WR-ARQA==)
---
MAGA is employing a full court press strategy to pursue every advantage they have to rig the 2026 midterm and stack the deck in their favor ahead of the 2028 presidential election.
They are throwing everything at the wall and seeing what sticks: launching lawsuits to overturn vote-by-mail laws, unwinding grace periods for ballots, seizing 2020 election results in swing states, threatening to deploy ICE and the FBI at polling places, and pushing Trump's massive voter suppression bill, the SAVE Act.
But the crown jewel of MAGA's election rigging work is red state redistricting. They are already up +10 blue-to-red districts and counting, with more coming from Florida's upcoming gerrymander.
Virginia's redistricting ballot measure is far from a sure thing. Colorado Draws The Line is ground zero for Democrats. Three GOP-held seats are at stake, and they could make the difference for which party controls the House.

[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor
This week, the Senate debated a bill — called the SAVE America Act — whose
sole purpose is to make it harder to vote.

Republicans marketing this bill may make it sound reasonable, they say,
after all, you need to show ID to board a plane or rent a car. Why should
voting be any different?

What they aren’t telling you, is if this bill passes,
they don’t want to allow you to use that same ID to vote. Your regular
driver’s license? Won’t qualify. Your REAL ID? Won’t qualify.

Unless you provide your birth certificate or passport — and haven’t
changed your name since obtaining those documents — you would not be able
to vote under the SAVE America Act.

Let’s be clear, this bill will not save
America. It is nothing more than an attempt to keep eligible voters from
voting. And it’s yet another pathetic ploy by Trump and his allies to
abuse their power.

# Chuck Norris dead at 86

Iconic actor and martial artist Chuck Norris **[died Thursday morning](https://substack.com/redirect/b63fbc10-6f88-46f0-ac48-8cae7fb77b50?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** surrounded by family, according to a statement posted on his Instagram account Friday.
The family statement said "to the world, he was a martial artist, actor, and a symbol of strength. To us, he was a devoted husband, a loving father and grandfather, an incredible brother, and the heart of our family," adding he "lived his life with faith, purpose, and an unwavering commitment to the people he loved" and "inspired millions around the world."
The family asked for privacy while grieving, thanking fans for their love and support during his recent hospitalization, noting "to him, you were not just fans, you were his friends."

# **Planned Parenthood Illinois pays $500K after segregating employees by race into mandatory "affinity caucuses"**
Planned Parenthood's Illinois chapter agreed to pay $500,000 after a federal Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) investigation **[found reasonable cause to believe the organization segregated employees by race](https://substack.com/redirect/b11d30eb-c854-4735-84bc-821fef4ee90c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** into mandatory "affinity networks," with employees of other races barred from participating.
**What happened:** Every week, staff were required to attend one- to two-hour sessions of segregated racial caucuses or DEI training, where white employees allegedly faced harassment and derogatory statements like "white supremacy is exerted at every level of oppression."
**Why it matters:** EEOC Chair Andrea Lucas said "segregating employees by race violates the core promise of our nation's civil rights laws," emphasizing Title VII guarantees equal treatment and "those protections equally apply to white workers." The investigation, prompted by multiple employee complaints, found Planned Parenthood "denied white employees access to time off that it granted only to black employees." The organization fired the manager responsible for the misconduct uncovered by the investigation.
**The broader context:** Nineteen of 49 Planned Parenthood affiliates have issued statements acknowledging racism in their organizations, with Planned Parenthood of the Pacific Southwest saying "we must confront how white supremacy of the past and present continues in the institutions we are a part of today including our own organization."

The family statement said "to the world, he was a martial artist, actor, and a symbol of strength. To us, he was a devoted husband, a loving father and grandfather, an incredible brother, and the heart of our family," adding he "lived his life with faith, purpose, and an unwavering commitment to the people he loved" and "inspired millions around the world." The family asked for privacy while grieving, thanking fans for their love and support during his recent hospitalization, noting "to him, you were not just fans, you were his friends." Uncanny! Florida man forced to deny being Jeffrey Epstein after viral video sparks conspiracy theories A Florida man became "a viral sensation" after someone filmed him driving his convertible on I-95, The silver-haired, square-jawed stranger later addressed his phone "blowing up" in an Instagram clip liked over a million times, saying "I'm not Jeffrey Epstein. I'm Palm Beach Pete!" Why it matters: The uncanny resemblance kept conspiracy theories spinning, especially given lingering fascination around Epstein's 2019 death in a Manhattan jail cell, officially ruled a suicide but continuing to fuel online speculation. Many netizens wondered why "Palm Beach Pete" hadn't done more to disguise his look, with one writing "dude has to get this constantly. Time to grow a beard," while others joked about conspiracy theories that Epstein's death was murder, quipping "I'm sorry to hear about your car accident next week man." The backdrop: The story remains in headlines as the Justice Department releases batches of Epstein files following pressure from lawmakers and disclosure requirements, though not all documents have been made public and some material remains redacted beyond victims' names. The resemblance was especially striking given Epstein's Florida home and status as a notorious sex trafficker whom many conspiracy theorists refuse to believe is dead. Planned Parenthood Illinois pays $500K after segregating employees by race into mandatory "affinity caucuses" Planned Parenthood's Illinois chapter agreed to pay $500,000 after a federal Equal Employment Opportunity Commission (EEOC) investigation into mandatory "affinity networks," with employees of other races barred from participating. What happened: Every week, staff were required to attend one- to two-hour sessions of segregated racial caucuses or DEI training, where white employees allegedly faced harassment and derogatory statements like "white supremacy is exerted at every level of oppression." Why it matters: EEOC Chair Andrea Lucas said "segregating employees by race violates the core promise of our nation's civil rights laws," emphasizing Title VII guarantees equal treatment and "those protections equally apply to white workers." The investigation, prompted by multiple employee complaints, found Planned Parenthood "denied white employees access to time off that it granted only to black employees." The organization fired the manager responsible for the misconduct uncovered by the investigation. The broader context: Nineteen of 49 Planned Parenthood affiliates have issued statements acknowledging racism in their organizations, with Planned Parenthood of the Pacific Southwest saying "we must confront how white supremacy of the past and present continues in the institutions we are a part of today including our own organization." ### For Immediate Release:
### March 20, 2026

## Hope Scheppelman Suspends 2026 Campaign for U.S. Congress

Washington, D.C. \- Today, Hope Scheppelman, candidate for Colorado's 3rd Congressional District, announced she has suspended her surging campaign to unseat freshman Republican Jeff Hurd. Citing President Trump's request to withdraw, Scheppelman put the need to help preserve the Republican Party's slim majority in the U.S. House and America First ahead of her personal ambitions.
"While my decision was difficult to make, I must put America First and do all I can to help ensure that the radical leaders in today's Democrat Party do not take this seat and thereby plunge our great country into the destructive chaos we experienced during the Biden-Pelosi era," said Scheppelman.
"Jeff Hurd now has the opportunity to correct his naive voting record and support President Trump, and our slim Republican majority in the U.S. House, in our shared battle to save the country we love. If he does not, I will run again in 2028 and defeat him in order to give the citizens of Colorado's 3rd district, and all of America, the representation we deserve," continued Scheppelman.
"To all my supporters, I encourage you to hold Jeff Hurd's feet to the fire and demand he do his job to uphold the Constitution and advance the values that are making America great again. Our vigilance to put our country ahead of ourselves is the price we must pay to ensure our freedom and prosperity are preserved for our fellow citizens," concluded Hope Scheppelman. ###

| Letter from the Chair
---
Fellow Republicans,
I've had a very difficult time focusing on politics this week. With record-breaking wildfires in Central and Western Nebraska, my mind constantly goes to those who are suffering the loss of home, livestock, feed, and grassland. My mind also goes to the first responders - our law enforcement, firefighters, and medical personnel - who show up to work when needed despite their own personal obligations and risks to their property.
Many of us who live in rural areas rely on volunteer firefighters. The volunteer fire departments struggle for funding for equipment, maintenance, and training. Let's take some time in the upcoming weeks to show some appreciation to our volunteers by donating to them with a note of thanks.
Tragically one person has lost her life to the wildfires so far, but thanks be to God that there wasn't more loss of human life. As becoming Nebraskans, many fire departments and volunteers have shown up to fight the fires and serve the communities. As I write this, the fires are becoming more contained as time passes and winds subside. Let's continue to pray that we stay on this trajectory.
Ironically while the wildfires were building, eastern parts of the state suffered high winds and blizzard conditions last weekend that resulted in two deaths and we keep their families in prayer. None of us knows what the day will bring.
As a result of dangerous roads and low visibility, Wayne County Republicans had to reschedule their county convention from last Sunday to Friday April 10th. The NEGOP will keep an eye on other county conventions if they must be rescheduled.
Praying that the coming days bring us better tidings and that our western brothers and sisters can soon begin the long journey towards healing. May God show mercy on us all.
For Nebraska, Mary Jane Truemper Chairman, Nebraska Republican Party

| >From the Office of Attorney General Mike Hilgers...
One of my most important jobs as your Attorney General is protecting our election process. As Attorney General, we have achieved a number of felony convictions tied to election misconduct, and just last month we obtained a 23-count conviction of official misconduct tied to the recent marijuana petition efforts. An important part of keeping our elections fair is ensuring that they are decided by the people who actually live here--not outsiders halfway around the world. That's why we filed a major lawsuit last November to stop a far-left Swiss billionaire from secretly pouring foreign money into our ballot measures. Here's what's happening. A man named Hansjorg Wyss, worth billions and living in Switzerland, has sent more than $10 million into Nebraska to secretly fund ballot initiatives. He didn't write checks directly to ballot campaigns. Instead, the money traveled through a web of national nonprofits--groups with names most Nebraskans have never heard--before landing in local committees pushing big changes to our laws. This amount of money is enormous, and very difficult to fight here in Nebraska. Just last election cycle, he helped fund measures on paid sick leave, medical marijuana, and abortion. We investigated and revealed the money trail: Wyss sent money to his foundations, which sent money to national dark-money groups, and eventually straight into the ballot committees. All of it violates a simple Nebraska law we passed in 2022 when I served as Speaker of the Legislature: foreign nationals are not allowed to spend money on ballot questions. This matters to every family in Lincoln, every farmer in the Sandhills, and every small-business owner in Scottsbluff. Our state constitution and our way of life should be shaped by Nebraskans who understand our values, our challenges, and our communities. Not by a foreign billionaire who will never set foot in our state or feel the consequences of the changes he's trying to buy. That's why we acted. My office followed the money, documented every step, and sued Wyss and the six main groups in Madison County. We're asking the judge for a clear order: stop the illegal flow now and keep it stopped. We're not trying to undo past elections. We're just trying to protect future ones. Nebraska belongs to Nebraskans. We will not sit quietly while someone tries to buy our ballot box. With your support, we will keep fighting until the law is respected and our voice is the only one that decides our future. Mike Hilgers
-

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASEMarch 20, 2026[katherine@julialetlow.com](mailto:katherine@julialetlow.com)
**National Conservative Women’s Group Maggie’s List Backs Julia Letlow for U.S. Senate** _Endorsement Highlights Letlow’s Record of Delivering for Louisiana Families, Jobs, and Key Industries._
**BATON ROUGE, LA** – Today, Congresswoman Julia Letlow, the Trump-endorsed candidate for U.S. Senate in Louisiana, announced she has received the endorsement of Maggie’s List, a national organization dedicated to electing conservative women to federal office.
Maggie’s List recognized Rep. Letlow’s strong conservative leadership and her record of delivering for Louisiana families, workers, and key industries that drive the state’s economy.
_“Congresswoman Letlow has been a valuable advocate for Louisiana,”_**said Maggie’s List Louisiana Chairwoman Heidi Martin.**_“Her tireless efforts for Louisiana’s families, farmers and the energy industry have led to tremendous strides in making Louisiana a big part of the president’s plan to Make America Great Again!”_
Rep. Letlow said she is honored to have the support of Maggie’s List and emphasized her commitment to continuing the fight for Louisiana values in the U.S. Senate.
_“I am grateful for the support of Maggie’s List and for their commitment to electing strong conservative women who are willing to step up and serve,”_**said Rep. Letlow.** _“In Congress, I’ve worked to protect Louisiana jobs, strengthen our schools, and stand up for the industries that power our state. In the U.S. Senate, I will keep fighting to put Louisiana families first, defend our values, and stand with President Trump to move our country forward.”_
Rep. Letlow’s endorsement from Maggie’s List adds to a growing coalition of support from conservative leaders and grassroots organizations across Louisiana as momentum continues to build ahead of the May 16 Republican primary.

subject: 🎉 A win for healthcare! / ¡Una victoria para la cuidado de salud! 🎉
body:
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/PNG%202023%20TOP%20Newsletter%20Header.png]
Lea el boletín en español abajo [#Español]
📣 ORGANIZING WORKS 📣
TOP helps secure the expansion of Ben Taub Hospital in Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Enhanced%20-%20Ben%20Taub%20vote%20leaders.jpg]
MOVEMENT VICTORY: TOP staff and members spoke in support of the proposed expansion of Ben Taub Hospital today at Harris County Commissioners Court, and commissioners made the right call by unanimously voting for the plan. [https://www.fox26houston.com/news/houston-ben-taub-hospital-expansion-approved-hermann-park-harris-county]
Healthcare is a human right at TOP, and this expansion of Ben Taub is a step in the right direction for healthcare justice in Harris County , as it will alleviate overcrowding and long wait times at the hospital.
Our communities are at their strongest when every person in need of medical assistance — no matter their age, race, faith, or gender — can receive the quality treatment they deserve.
Healthier families lead to healthier workers, as well as a healthier and more prosperous Harris County!
For more about this healthcare organizing win, email Damaris at dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] .
TAKE TOP'S SURVEY:
Tell us how healthcare impacts YOU
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bexar%20County%20Healthcare%20pic.jpg]
Speaking of healthcare, TOP wants to hear from YOU!
From restricted healthcare access to health insurance premiums rising, we know it's not getting any easier to see a doctor or get affordable medical treatment in Trump 2.0.
Weigh in on what REAL healthcare looks like to you, and share your personal story.
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoc1OUiuz2TfuWAMFfFO2p2m3ti1xB9QGZzEjIya3BgLA9EA/viewform [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSfoc1OUiuz2TfuWAMFfFO2p2m3ti1xB9QGZzEjIya3BgLA9EA/viewform]
Apply to join Team Teal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/We%20are%20hiring%20-%20English.png]
If you or someone you know cares deeply about social justice and transforming our state so Black and Latino Texans have the political power they deserve, then check out TOP’s current job openings. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top/employment/]
Don't hesitate to connect us to any talented and passionate community members you have in mind!
Feel free to email recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] with any questions or to apply.
TRUMP TRACKER:
He's destroying our environment to enrich his donor friends
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Trump%20environment.jpg]
We're back with another edition of our Trump Tracker, where we apply Critical Ignoring [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] to help fight the right-wing's "flood the zone" [https://www.damemagazine.com/2026/02/24/trump-flood-the-zone-media-strategy/] messaging that seeks to divide, confuse, and demoralize us.
When it comes to environmental protections, Trump isn't just neglecting these protections, he's flat-out stripping them away.
More fracking, less regulations, and the covering up of climate science data. THIS sums up his environmental "work" in his second term.
Since coming back to office, he and MAGA have weakened water and air protections [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/jan/30/trump-epa-rollbacks-air-water-climate] , as well as moved to end the EPA's Office of Environmental Justice. [https://time.com/7271567/trump-project-2025-anti-climate-action/]
Not just that, wealthy fossil fuel executives are cheering him on [https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/analysis-opinion/fossil-fuel-industry-donors-see-major-returns-trumps-policies] , as he cuts "red tape" and essentially does their bidding.
Check out these four ways how Trump is sabotaging climate action around the world. [https://grist.org/politics/4-ways-trump-is-sabotaging-climate-action-around-the-world/]
Español
📣 ORGANIZARSE FUNCIONA 📣
TOP ayuda a asegurar la expansión del Hospital Ben Taub en Houston
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Enhanced%20-%20Ben%20Taub%20vote%20leaders.jpg]
¡VICTORIA DEL MOVIMIENTO! Hoy, el personal y los miembros de TOP intervinieron en la Corte de Comisionados del Condado de Harris para expresar su apoyo a la propuesta de ampliación del Hospital Ben Taub; los comisionados tomaron la decisión acertada al votar unánimemente a favor del plan. [https://www.fox26houston.com/news/houston-ben-taub-hospital-expansion-approved-hermann-park-harris-county]
En TOP, consideramos que la atención médica es un derecho humano; por ello, esta ampliación del Hospital Ben Taub representa un paso en la dirección correcta hacia la justici a - de salud en el Condado de Harris, ya que aliviará la saturación y los largos tiempos de espera en el hospital.
Nuestras comunidades alcanzan su mayor fortaleza cuando todas las personas que necesitan asistencia médica —sin importar su edad, raza, credo o género— pueden recibir el tratamiento de calidad que merecen.
¡Las familias más sanas dan lugar a trabajadores más sanos, así como a un Condado de Harris más saludable y próspero!
Para obtener más información sobre este triunfo en la organización de salud , comuníquese con Damaris a través de dgonzalez@organizetexas.org [dgonzalez@organizetexas.org] .
PARTICIPA EN LA ENCUESTA DE TOP:
Cuéntanos cómo te afecta a TI la atención médica
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Bexar%20County%20Healthcare%20pic.jpg]
Hablando de atención médica, ¡TOP quiere saber de TI!
Desde el acceso restringido a la atención médica hasta el aumento de las primas de los seguros de salud, sabemos que cada vez es más difícil ver a un médico u obtener un tratamiento médico asequible en la era de Trump 2.0.
Dinos qué significa para ti una atención médica REAL y comparte tu historia personal.
https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1bY_DlK7WwjhHEWsdJhb8yQSqAUdL3z_EEH_QepPF2HeAEw/viewform [https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSf1bY_DlK7WwjhHEWsdJhb8yQSqAUdL3z_EEH_QepPF2HeAEw/viewform]
Aplica para unirte al Equipo Teal
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Spanish%20-%20we%20are%20hiring.png]
Si tu o alguien que conoces se preocupa profundamente por la justicia social y por transformar nuestro estado para que los texanos negros y latinos tengan el poder político que merecen, echa un vistazo a las vacantes actuales de TOP. [https://organizetexas.org/about-top/employment/]
¡No dudes en ponernos en contacto con cualquier miembro de la comunidad talentoso y apasionado que tengas en mente!
No dudes en enviar un correo electrónico a recruit@organizetexas.org [recruit@organizetexas.org] si tienes alguna pregunta o para presentar tu solicitud.
RASTREADOR DE TRUMP:
Él está destruyendo nuestro medio ambiente para enriquecer a sus amigos donantes
[https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/TSM/TSMTO/1/45640/images/Trump%20environment.jpg]
Estamos de regreso con otra edición de nuestro Trump Tracker, donde aplicamos el ignoramiento crítico [https://www.psychologytoday.com/us/blog/misinformation-desk/202511/critical-ignoring-a-strategy-for-information-overload] para ayudar a combatir la estrategia comunicacional de la derecha de inundar la zona [https://www.damemagazine.com/2026/02/24/trump-flood-the-zone-media-strategy/] , la cual busca dividirnos, confundirnos y desmoralizarnos.
En lo que respecta a la protección del medio ambiente, Trump no se limita a descuidar dichas salvaguardas; las está eliminando de plano.
Más fracking, menos regulaciones y el encubrimiento de datos científicos sobre el clima: ESTO resume su labor medioambiental durante su segundo mandato.
Desde su regreso al cargo, tanto él como el movimiento MAGA han debilitado las normativas de protección del agua y del aire [https://www.theguardian.com/environment/2026/jan/30/trump-epa-rollbacks-air-water-climate] , además de impulsar el cierre de la Oficina de Justicia Ambiental de la EPA. [https://time.com/7271567/trump-project-2025-anti-climate-action/]
Y no solo eso: los acaudalados ejecutivos de la industria de los combustibles fósiles lo vitorean mientras él recorta la burocracia [https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/analysis-opinion/fossil-fuel-industry-donors-see-major-returns-trumps-policies] y, en esencia, actúa a su servicio.
Descubra estas cuatro formas en las que Trump está saboteando la acción climática en todo el mundo. [https://grist.org/politics/4-ways-trump-is-sabotaging-climate-action-around-the-world/]

President Donald Trump has said that he is leading a "movement" to get rid of mail-in ballots and voting machines , falsely claiming that they lead to voter fraud.

Trump has long lied about mail-in voting. He's claimed mail-in voting contributed to his 2020 election loss, though no widespread fraud has been found. In fact, the one case of mail-in ballot fraud in Pennsylvania after the 2020 election was a man who was prosecuted for returning his dead mother's ballot for Trump .
We all know just how safe and secure mail-in voting is. It's use dates back to the Civil War. The use of mail-in voting has become very common across the country and study after study has shown that fraud in mail-ballot voting is rare. There are also several safeguards in place nationwide to protect against fraud, including signature requirements and barcodes to track envelopes sent by officials. States have spent tens of millions of taxpayer dollars investigating voter fraud since 2020's "big lie" and found virtually nothing.
Being blunt: There is no good-faith reason to limit vote-by-mail access. There is no good-faith reason to end the use of mail-in voting, or do the other things in this forthcoming executive order or his previous one attacking vote-by-mail. Just like the wave of redistricting efforts in Texas, Florida, and beyond -- this is a partisan voter suppression exercise meant to codify MAGA's power in perpetuity and end our democracy.

body:
Will you stand with us? | [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127713316/608982669/-1977837920?refcode=3.20.26_WomEndrsmnts2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83ODg3MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJmMzExOGY1ZC03MzI0LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=DT1xAhO0BVWjOyvA2opa8XUSzcCW2oxrMMLuYNaFkw4=&emci=7c046f1e-bf23-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=f3118f5d-7324-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=53531271)
---
Friend, **I’m proud to be endorsed by a growing list of incredible women** who are tireless advocates for their communities across Tennessee. _**Senator Heidi Campbell**_ has been an inspiration to this campaign, having flipped her district seat blue in 2020. She has a proven record of fighting for women and working to pass policies that create opportunities for all Tennesseans. Candidate for Shelby County Commission’s 13th District, and sitting **Memphis-Shelby County School Board Member Amber Huett-Garcia** , has been a steady voice for education funding, accountability, and enhancing school performance, as well as a champion for women’s healthcare in Tennessee. As a woman currently serving my community on the Memphis City Council, I’m also so honored to have the support of my colleague, **Memphis City Councilwoman Pearl Walker** , as well as**Pikeville Board of Aldermen Vice Mayor Jeania Lansing** , and **Covington Alderwoman Jean Johnson** – each one, dedicated to the needs of their neighborhoods and communities and ensuring that women not only have a seat at the table, but also a say in what’s on the agenda.

**Each of these endorsements reminds me why this campaign matters:** women across Tennessee still face challenges accessing _**reproductive healthcare**_ , **childcare** , and **equal pay** and **equal opportunities** , and _**we need leaders at every level fighting for them.**_ Your support keeps this movement going. Whether showing up at a town hall, sharing our message, or helping us cover the costs of reaching voters across the state, every action counts. clean_body: Will you stand with us? | Friend, I’m proud to be endorsed by a growing list of incredible women who are tireless advocates for their communities across Tennessee. Senator Heidi Campbell has been an inspiration to this campaign, having flipped her district seat blue in 2020. She has a proven record of fighting for women and working to pass policies that create opportunities for all Tennesseans. Candidate for Shelby County Commission’s 13th District, and sitting Memphis-Shelby County School Board Member Amber Huett-Garcia , has been a steady voice for education funding, accountability, and enhancing school performance, as well as a champion for women’s healthcare in Tennessee. As a woman currently serving my community on the Memphis City Council, I’m also so honored to have the support of my colleague, Memphis City Councilwoman Pearl Walker , as well asPikeville Board of Aldermen Vice Mayor Jeania Lansing , and Covington Alderwoman Jean Johnson – each one, dedicated to the needs of their neighborhoods and communities and ensuring that women not only have a seat at the table, but also a say in what’s on the agenda. Each of these endorsements reminds me why this campaign matters: women across Tennessee still face challenges accessing reproductive healthcare , childcare , and equal pay and equal opportunities , and we need leaders at every level fighting for them. Earlier this week, Senator Warner officially qualified for the ballot in Virginia – which means this week is critical for our campaign. We need to come out of the gate strong and we’re counting on grassroots donors like you to help us.

[_**This is your last chance to become an Official Founding Donor to Mark Warner’s reelection campaign – can we count on you to pitch in today?**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127714335/608983726/1037320630?refcode=MW_ATA_EM_FR_FoundingDonor_260320_T1_1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODY1NCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJlNDExOGY1ZC03MzI0LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=-0Tvg_b1NxPwqCEBldOMq0YrLc9Cou4_JWPWtV409cE=)

Senator Warner is running for reelection – asking Virginians to rehire him as their U.S. Senator – because the challenges we’re facing require real leadership. Prices are skyrocketing. The job market is shifting underneath our feet. Americans are facing a health care crisis.

**And the worst part is that we have a president and an administration that aren’t doing a damn thing about it – they’re too focused on erecting new monuments across D.C. and peddling conspiracy theories about the 2020 election.**

We need to reelect Mark and elect Democrats across the Commonwealth who will stand up to the chaos and corruption coming out of Washington.

But to make it happen, we need you with us, Derek. We need to finish out this filing week in a strong position – the resources we raise now determine the strength of our campaign in the weeks and months ahead.

Also, Combatting CCP Influence, AI+ Expo, ringing in America250, and more.

| | Hi Peter,
7 years ago, a few principled veteran leaders in Congress came together to found a new caucus that would be “[committed to working together across the aisle and adhere to placing principles before politics.](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=72eb08136a&e=33f53a5b1a)”
Since then, the [For Country Caucus](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=fa98750ec9&e=33f53a5b1a) has brought together nearly 40 Republican and Democratic veterans committed to working across the aisle to strengthen America’s national security, increase national service, and support America’s veterans and military families, advancing over 200 bipartisan initiatives that reflect the values of those who have worn the uniform.
Earlier this week, With Honor Action hosted a reception celebrating the Caucus’s 7th anniversary, bringing together leaders from both parties committed to service. [Watch](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=0e37a81bfc&e=33f53a5b1a) remarks from Founding Co-Chair and Air Force veteran **Rep. Don Bacon** (R-NE), current Co-Chair and Air Force veteran **Rep. Don Davis** (D-NC), and Vice Chairs, Air Force veterans **Rep. Herb Conaway** (D-NJ) and **Rep. Troy Downing** (R-MT).
This anniversary is an opportunity to reflect on that mission and celebrate the Members who continue to lead by example in a divided political climate. Read more about the anniversary event and a few of the Caucus’s accomplishments [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=1c4cf3640a&e=33f53a5b1a).

# For Country Caucus Members Introduce Bill to Combat CCP Influence
---
[|
---](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=a0c2974e68&e=33f53a5b1a)
| | On March 18, For Country Caucus member **Rep. Derek Tran** (D-CA) introduced the Combatting Chinese Communist Party Influence Act, alongside For Country Caucus members **Reps. Don Bacon** (R-NE) and **Pat Harrigan** (R-NC).
With Honor Action was proud to endorse this bill to assess the impact of the Chinese Communist Party's foreign malign influence operations in key regions across the globe, and their implications on U.S. national security. In February, With Honor [submitted](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=89577aa824&e=33f53a5b1a) this bill alongside our other priorities for inclusion in the [FY27 National Defense Authorization Act](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=85cfe8d3d4&e=33f53a5b1a). We thank For Country Caucus members Reps. Tran, Bacon, and Harrigan, as well as Rep. Marilyn Strickland, for their commitment to defending American credibility abroad.
Read more about this bill [here](https://withhonor.us16.list-manage.com/track/click?u=80940e6d1b1e08928d721cf8d&id=d6c0e46777&e=33f53a5b1a).

Derek,

As an Air Force veteran and a member of the House Armed Services and Intelligence Committees, I have spent years focused on sober, fact-based analysis of global threats. What I’m seeing today is unlike anything I have witnessed before. I know the news cycle is moving at warp speed, but I wanted to stop for a moment and share with you what I’m doing to hold the Trump administration accountable.
**The War in Iran and the Erosion of Accountability**

The administration has launched us into a widening conflict with Iran without evidence that Iran posed an imminent threat, a clear strategy, or a single vote of authorization from the people’s representatives. This is why I voted in favor of the War Powers Act. The Constitution is clear: no President, regardless of party, has the unilateral authority to wage an open-ended war.
**Investigating the "Armageddon" Claims**

Incredibly disturbing are whistleblower reports from active-duty service members that some military leaders are telling troops that this war is part of a "divine plan" to bring about Armageddon and the return of Jesus Christ and that the President was "anointed" to light the "signal fire" in Iran.

If true, this is a staggering violation of the separation of church and state and a direct threat to the religious freedom of our troops. In response, I have called for an immediate DOD Inspector General investigation into these claims. Military operations must be guided by the Constitution and the law, not by apocalyptic theology. Our service members sign up to defend our democracy, not to be pawns in a religious prophecy. We need an investigation immediately to ensure our chain of command hasn't been compromised by extremist rhetoric.
**Bankrolling Russia’s War Against Ukraine**

Because the war in Iran has closed the Strait of Hormuz, paralyzing global energy markets and sending gas prices through the roof, the Trump administration has done the unthinkable: loosened sanctions on Russian oil. By allowing Russian tankers back into the global market, we are handing Vladimir Putin a multi-billion dollar lifeline to keep funding his war against Ukraine. As someone who has been personally sanctioned by Russia for pushing the U.S. government to do more to help Ukraine, I find this action abhorrent. I will keep pushing to end the war and reinstate sanctions against Russia.

I am doing everything in my power to bring "disciplined oversight" back to Washington. We are fighting for the very fabric of our democracy and the safety of our men and women in uniform.
There's work to be done,

Chrissy

clean_body: | | | Derek, As an Air Force veteran and a member of the House Armed Services and Intelligence Committees, I have spent years focused on sober, fact-based analysis of global threats. What I’m seeing today is unlike anything I have witnessed before. I know the news cycle is moving at warp speed, but I wanted to stop for a moment and share with you what I’m doing to hold the Trump administration accountable. The War in Iran and the Erosion of Accountability The administration has launched us into a widening conflict with Iran without evidence that Iran posed an imminent threat, a clear strategy, or a single vote of authorization from the people’s representatives. This is why I voted in favor of the War Powers Act. The Constitution is clear: no President, regardless of party, has the unilateral authority to wage an open-ended war. Investigating the "Armageddon" Claims Incredibly disturbing are whistleblower reports from active-duty service members that some military leaders are telling troops that this war is part of a "divine plan" to bring about Armageddon and the return of Jesus Christ and that the President was "anointed" to light the "signal fire" in Iran. If true, this is a staggering violation of the separation of church and state and a direct threat to the religious freedom of our troops. In response, I have called for an immediate DOD Inspector General investigation into these claims. Military operations must be guided by the Constitution and the law, not by apocalyptic theology. Our service members sign up to defend our democracy, not to be pawns in a religious prophecy. We need an investigation immediately to ensure our chain of command hasn't been compromised by extremist rhetoric. Bankrolling Russia’s War Against Ukraine Because the war in Iran has closed the Strait of Hormuz, paralyzing global energy markets and sending gas prices through the roof, the Trump administration has done the unthinkable: loosened sanctions on Russian oil. By allowing Russian tankers back into the global market, we are handing Vladimir Putin a multi-billion dollar lifeline to keep funding his war against Ukraine. As someone who has been personally sanctioned by Russia for pushing the U.S. government to do more to help Ukraine, I find this action abhorrent. I will keep pushing to end the war and reinstate sanctions against Russia. I am doing everything in my power to bring "disciplined oversight" back to Washington. name: Sara Jacobs
subject: Trump: it’s “a very small price to pay”
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Sara Jacobs for Congress
body:
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25 [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/sjj-em?amount=25]
Our country spent $11.3 billion on just the first six days of Trump’s war of choice in Iran.
That’s more than a billion dollars a day that could have been invested in affordable health care, housing, child care, or practically infinite other needs to help the American people.
And now, gas prices are going up – nearly SIX DOLLARS a gallon in San Diego, more than a $1 increase since the start of the war.
[https://d15k2d11r6t6rl.cloudfront.net/public/users/Integrators/04eaa6b2-88f4-43b4-b978-7bb0708f5838/4B56703331706B763761575761684F616445307A664443746C6755636247484F68617A6B5074506255714B37736546697A2F4845487434734278303131755557/editor_images/Screenshot%202026-03-20%20at%2010.57.45%E2%80%AFAM.png]
But that’s OK, because Trump called all this “a very small price to pay.”
Tell that to the tens of millions of people who are already struggling to cover their basic needs like groceries and rent.
The costs of Trump’s reckless war are rising by the day, and all of us – the American people, our service members, Iranian civilians – are paying the price, in every sense of the word.
Already 13 U.S. service members have been killed and more than 200 wounded – and the Trump administration can’t even get their messaging straight on whether we’re at war with Iran.
There’s no clear objective, no defined endgame, and no plan for what comes next.
More than a thousand Iranian civilians have reportedly been killed since the start of this war.
Nearly 200 Iranian people, most of them little girls, were killed in a school attack later proven to be from U.S. forces.
Please tell me how killing literal children makes us any safer?
Some of the devastation we can’t even begin to calculate. We’ve seen apocalyptic photos coming out of Tehran. Plumes of orange and black smoke filling the city air after Iran’s oil infrastructure was struck. Toxic smoke, polluted drinking water, the trauma of war – all of it will have significant impacts on people’s health for years to come.
This is the reality of Trump’s illegal war. Rising costs, mounting casualties and civilian harms, and no plan to get out.
We’ve seen this show before, and we know exactly how it ends. Trump’s massive strategic mistake will have long-reaching national security implications, won’t make Americans any safer, and will impact our collective future.
We need to end this reckless war now – full stop.
I’m doing everything I can in the House to hold this administration accountable, and I’m going to continue demanding answers to the most basic questions about this administration’s strategy, intentions, and potential costs of this war with Iran. And I won’t support any funding for Trump’s misguided regime change war and military adventurism.
Right now, it’s important that we all continue to speak out and stand up for what we believe.
I hope you’ll continue reaching out to your representatives regularly to share your strong opposition to continued war. Public outcries do matter, and we’ve seen countless times during this administration that they can make an impact.
I’ll keep updating you as this situation evolves and we learn more.
Thanks for reading.
–Sara

name: Rick Larsen
subject: Elections should belong to voters, not billionaires
disclaimer_text: Paid for and authorized by Citizens to Elect Rick Larsen
body:
Greater disclosure and stronger campaign finance laws are critical steps to ensuring our democracy works for people, not secret donors.
| | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/127717196/608992011/-201694504?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTMvMS84NzY1OSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzMWEwMzhiNC03NjI0LWYxMTEtOWE0OC0wMDBkM2ExNGI2NDAiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=zJkc8_ayvJfWP1ugTLwkM6EfxxFt8pO8aDQGMjEfKzs=&emci=917be5c3-861d-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&emdi=31a038b4-7624-f111-9a48-000d3a14b640&ceid=9494239)
---

| | Folks in Northwest Washington deserve to participate in a fair election and have the right to know who is spending money to influence elections. But in today's political environment, wealthy special interests and dark money groups are spending millions to influence elections while hiding who is actually funding those efforts. **That kind of secrecy undermines trust in our democracy and leaves working families wondering whose interests are really being represented.** For years, I have supported efforts to increase transparency in our elections and shine a light on dark money spending so voters know exactly who is trying to influence their vote. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]

Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. | | Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw

Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]
