Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18] | | | | | | Dear Reader, Trump signed Executive Order 14365. Hi friends,
I'm excited to share this.
**Our new online ad just launched, and I hope you 'll take a minute to watch it:**
[](https://substack.com/redirect/daaa08bf-16fa-4e39-a974-6e67c9d366bb?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
I'm proud of this ad because it focuses on the work I'm doing to stand up and fight for Michigan amid Donald Trump's chaos.
But I think it gets at something deeper, too - about who I am, what I believe, and what this race is really about.
**At the end of the day, I 'm laser-focused on delivering for Michigan. That's just what I do.**
There's so much chaos in the world right now that it can feel like every day brings another wave of overwhelming news.
But I've always believed that when you show up for people, listen to them, and then lead, good things can happen. Legislation gets passed. Social Security gets protected. Manufacturing jobs get saved.
**That 's what this ad shows: [I know how to win for Michigan.](https://substack.com/redirect/9f986d80-66ee-4212-b464-d6d82a570b9f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** And I know how to deliver for Michigan.
It's why I was named the most effective Michigan Democrat in Congress, and why I'm the only candidate in this race with such widespread support from labor.
_That matters a lot to me._
Not because of status - but because this coalition is built on trust. It's about showing people that you hear their concerns, you can do the work, and you can actually get things done.
That's been the throughline of my whole career.
It was true when I worked on President Obama's auto rescue and helped save 200,000 Michigan jobs.
It was true when I fought to bring advanced manufacturing and semiconductor investment back to our state.
And it's true now, as I push back against Trump's reckless tariffs that raise costs for working families and farmers and make life harder for the people working the hardest.
That's who I am. And that's what I wanted this ad to reflect.
**I 'll be honest: This campaign is deeply personal for me.** It's a love letter to Michigan - my home, my heart, and the people I care about most.
It's about the people who built this state and the people who keep it running every day.
It's about whether government is going to keep working for the wealthy and well-connected or whether it will finally start working for everyone else.
And it's about whether Michigan is going to have a senator who actually knows this state, loves this state, and has spent her career fighting for the people in it.
That's what I'm offering in this race.
I'm not just yelling into a bullhorn.
I'm going to work every day and fighting for Michigan. Bringing my grit. Getting results. All out of a deep love for Michigan.
**I know I may not be the flashiest thing in politics right now. In this ad, there 's just the media reporting the facts of what I've been able to accomplish for Michigan's working families.**
Because I think that's what really matters to people.

They want something steadier than that.
They want someone competent. Honest. Trustworthy.
Someone who understands that leadership is about service. Not self-promotion. It's about seeing a problem and fixing it. It's about making life better for your neighbor.
That's the Michigan way.
And that's the spirit behind this ad. It's also the opposite of Mike Rogers.
I'm backed by this grassroots team. **He 's backed by a MAGA Texas oil billionaire.**
I'm fighting for working families. **He 's fighting for Donald Trump and his wealthy backers.**
Republicans are spending big because they know Michigan is a battleground. They know the polls show we're tied with Rogers. They know this seat could help decide the Senate. And they know that if we keep reaching Michiganders with our message, we will win this race.
That's why I wanted to send you this directly. So if you haven't watched it yet, I hope you will.
With grit and gratitude,
Haley

I am excited to reveal that my 5th book is now available for pre-order: Trump 2.0
This is the first book to examine the consequential impact of Trump's non-sequential terms in office. His ability to come back to office after 4 year of planning and plotting -- the difference that the people, process and policies of Trump 2.0 will make and why they will be historic.
I am honored that President Trump offered to write the foreword for the book,
**I want to share EXCLUSIVELY** with you part of what President Trump wrote:
_" In everything we do, we are fighting for the law-abiding, hardworking_
_people of our country. This is the essence of "Trump 2.0,"_
_and there are few people who understand it better than my friend and_
_former White House Press Secretary Sean Spicer. Sean has been with_
_us since the beginning. He played a central role in helping us defeat_
_Crooked Hillary Clinton in 2016 --and he has been a warrior for our_
_cause ever since._
_If you want to understand the people, the policies, and the process_
_of my second term in office, read this book. I hope you enjoy it, and_

Derek - Here’s my plan for how we win this election:
This is a ground game campaign. This is person-to-person, human-to-human, mukluk telegraph.
For those in the Lower 48, mukluk telegraph is a saying we have in the Bush that basically amounts to gossip.
It’s passing along a message through our conversations with one another, _which is the only way information can really spread in some parts of the Last Frontier!_
In a state as vast and rural as ours, there really is no other way to reach every Alaskan. That’s why it’s so important for us to travel to their communities and have those person-to-person conversations.
There are 585,000 square miles in this state — bigger than Texas, California, and Montana combined. And we’re going to criss-cross it in its entirety.
But to be honest with you, reaching every community will be expensive.
More than 80% of our communities can only be reached by plane, boat or snow machine. And when we are able to drive, gas up here costs much more than it does in most of the Lower 48!
But we don’t have another option. I’m running for U.S. Senate to fight for all Alaskans, and I’m committed to bringing every borough into this fight with me.
That’s why I’m asking for your support today. We need to take our message across Alaska, and we can’t do it without your help.
[**So if you’re with me, please split a donation today between the DNC and my campaign for U.S. Senate in Alaska. # Trump Gold Coin advances as Treasury grants rare authority
The U.S. Mint is pushing forward with a **[commemorative gold coin featuring President Donald Trump](https://substack.com/redirect/bc726b9f-f6c5-4ecd-80c2-063c28a2366f?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** after the Commission of Fine Arts approved the design Thursday, with Treasury invoking rare statutory authority to feature a sitting president on a non-circulating bullion coin for the 2026 semiquincentennial.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/7e12984d-b93f-424b-8f48-4422ec3019f5?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Design Approval Secured:** CFA greenlit obverse portrait of Trump from official White House photo and reverse bald eagle; tied to America's 250th anniversary celebrations.
* **Treasury Cites Statute:** Officials rely on 31 U.S.C. § 5112 granting Secretary discretion over bullion/proof gold coin designs, bypassing traditional bans on living persons in currency.
* **Treasurer Enthusiastic Quote:** Brandon Beach called Trump "no profile more emblematic" for representing U.S. democracy and spirit in the limited-production coin.
* **Precedent Breaking Move:** Marks rare government-issued coin with sitting president; separate from circulating money rules, with final specs pending Secretary decision.

# Super Micro execs charged over smuggling Nvidia chips to China
U.S. prosecutors unsealed charges Thursday against Super Micro Computer co-founder Yih-Shyan "Wally" Liaw and two associates for allegedly **[conspiring to divert $2.5 billion in Nvidia-powered AI servers to China](https://substack.com/redirect/815d02d8-4065-4b10-878e-40c05cefd2d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** since 2024, violating strict export controls by routing through a Southeast Asian middleman with fake paperwork and dummy setups, sparking a 25% plunge in Super Micro shares Friday.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/815d02d8-4065-4b10-878e-40c05cefd2d2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Scheme Details Emerge:** Defendants used fake documents, repackaging via logistics firms, dummy servers **[to deceive compliance audits](https://substack.com/redirect/dd077ba0-4289-40f5-a1cf-1e5047428489?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** , and put pressure on teams; $510 million in servers diverted late April to mid-May 2025 alone, featuring advanced Nvidia GPUs like B200 Blackwell architecture.
* **Key Figures Arrested:** Liaw (Super Micro co-founder, SVP, board member) and contractor Ting-Wei "Willy" Sun arrested Thursday; sales manager Ruei-Tsan "Steven" Chang remains fugitive; with no Commerce Department license obtained for China exports.
* **Super Micro Responds:** Company placed involved employees on leave, terminated contractor relationship, stated alleged conduct violated policies and controls; maintains robust compliance program and full adherence to U.S. export laws.
* **Broader Enforcement Push:** Part of an ongoing U.S. crackdown on unauthorized AI tech flows to China amid national security concerns; prosecutor Jay Clayton emphasized swift action against sensitive technology crimes.

* * *
* * *
# Nvidia $20B Groq deal faces anti-trust scrutiny
Nvidia's $20 billion licensing deal with AI chip startup Groq, sealed late 2025, **[drew sharp criticism from Sens. Elizabeth Warren and Richard Blumenthal](https://substack.com/redirect/35619f57-e5cf-4765-8e60-3be773eed968?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Thursday, who warned it may evade merger review and further entrench the company's dominance in AI computing amid fears of stifled competition.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/35619f57-e5cf-4765-8e60-3be773eed968?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Licensing Plus Talent Grab:** Nvidia secured non-exclusive access to Groq's IP while hiring key engineers including CEO Jonathan Ross; Groq stays independent but lost most software and hardware staff to Nvidia.
* **Senators Demand Details:** Warren and Blumenthal's letter to Jensen Huang questions if the structure deliberately avoids antitrust scrutiny, highlighting risks to innovation and U.S. tech leadership versus China.
* **Nvidia Defends Structure:** Company spokesperson emphasized no acquisition occurred, framing it as IP licensing and talent hires to advance accelerated computing for global customers.
* **Broader Trend Emerges:** Similar licensing-hiring deals by Big Tech have bypassed reviews; FTC scrutiny of such arrangements grows under current leadership.

* * *
# Crypto.com cuts workforce by 12% in AI pivot
Crypto.com announced Thursday it is laying off about 12% of its workforce **[to integrate AI enterprise-wide,](https://substack.com/redirect/060606a6-5386-4859-b595-3c32c808cb12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** with CEO Kris Marszalek warning that companies failing to adopt AI quickly will fail in the evolving industry.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/060606a6-5386-4859-b595-3c32c808cb12?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Targeted Role Reductions:** Layoffs hit positions unable to adapt to new AI-driven structure; all affected employees notified as of March 19, 2026.
* **CEO Strong Statement:** Marszalek posted on X that AI pivot is essential for survival, joining broader tech and crypto trend of efficiency-driven cuts.
* **Historical Context:** Follows Crypto.com's 20% global workforce reduction in 2023 after FTX collapse and focus on financial prudence.
* **Industry Pattern Emerges:** Increasing AI citations in job cuts across crypto firms to streamline operations amid market shifts.

# UK Gilt yields spike, highest since 2008
UK 10-year gilt yields **[surged to their highest since the 2008 crisis](https://substack.com/redirect/596548a2-0d4c-42c8-a5c2-03df8796e99d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** on Friday at 4.933%, driven by inflation fears from the U.S.-Israel war with Iran and energy shocks, pushing borrowing costs higher and complicating fiscal plans.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/596548a2-0d4c-42c8-a5c2-03df8796e99d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Yield Surge Details:** 10-year up 9 bps, 2-year up 11 bps to 4.513%; long-end gilts already over 5% pre-war, with sharp repricing since conflict began.
* **BOE Holds Rates:** MPC kept benchmark steady, citing near-term inflation rise from war; markets now expect hikes starting next month to at least 4.25%.
* **War Economic Shock:** UK's imported energy reliance amplifies oil/gas price surges post-Strait of Hormuz issues, fueling gilt sell-off.
* **Reeves Fiscal Pressure:** Finance Minister's rules face tighter margin as higher yields raise costs; February borrowing exceeded expectations at £14.3B.

* * *
* * *
# Gold rebounds and Silver slides over Iran Oil volatility
Spot gold edged up 0.3% to $4,662.51 Friday **[after heavy selling from U.S.-Israel Iran war fears,](https://substack.com/redirect/866221f2-ed90-4e36-a66a-b38fa0a74379?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)** while silver fell 1.7% to $71.62 amid oscillating oil prices and broader market volatility tied to geopolitical risks.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/866221f2-ed90-4e36-a66a-b38fa0a74379?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
* **Gold Weekly Loss Looms:** On track for 9% weekly drop after Thursday's 3% slide; 2025's 66% surge contrasts with 2026 volatility from war unwinds.
* **Silver Sharp Declines:** Extending losses for over 10% weekly drop; 2025's 135% rally faded with biggest single-day fall since 1980s in January.
* **Expert Views Volatility:** Analysts note retail and hedge fund exits after rally, with central bank buying as a long-term driver; but short-term fear trades dominate.
* **Oil War Link Persists:** Fluctuating Brent/WTI prices from the Iran conflict spark metals swings, with investors eyeing economic fallout and inflation.

Friend, This week, Muslims around the world celebrated Eid al-Fitr, which comes at the end of the holy month of Ramadan―a time of fasting and spiritual renewal. This is a time that deepens our strength, deepens our compassion, and brings people together in care for one another. But this Ramadan has also been incredibly difficult for our families, especially those with loved ones in Lebanon and in Palestine. We must value life here and around the world, including honoring the humanity of Arab and Muslim people. Please join me in sending love and healing to those who have lost loved ones and those who are celebrating Eid on top of the rubble of their masjids, homes, and schools. Together, we will continue to come together in community, support one another, and show resilience in the face of ongoing genocide and injustices. We will continue to push our government to end these illegal wars. We will continue to demand the humanity of all people, whether in my hometown of Detroit, in the halls of Congress, or in Gaza, the West Bank, and Lebanon. May we recommit to acting each day to honor and respect all human beings, especially people who are treated as less than human. Thank you for helping build a world with equity and dignity for all, no matter our backgrounds. Eid Mubarak, Rashida

Peter,
Want to know what MAGA is trying to put on the ballot in Colorado this November?
Anti-transgender sports bans. Restrictions on gender-affirming healthcare. Attacks on LGBTQ+ rights disguised as "parental rights" and "protecting children."

---
| [](https://6s79z9hbb.cc.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001QSwKlndALIirONxS5G0-OzVFQUTpe2tqI0RPg3o3fOjorqrxtLLz-aLtKXgYNr82f6fVn5PfqOPIP0sC--3IFnztlnNhXUtlJg5YzgO5cHiA7LRHcOsGnLX-hO6g0tJe_iAj5ByUZN8OdihSqHvh2Kp5WD6RLBlS5kx4gB53-J11XQyiR0xKyv9KU6vatUwVYRqFJlSqQEpFxUJk3_0yVkuup8zLb1bJ&c=N6HypGAIleS0W6HEeM1cdSTeAcmfFh8FPuCUsCyLGTclrRlIGFs47Q==&ch=BOjTrzCOYaUDVLZxbWZJWz6V7BE9dOxEnPkt2G3A10pgUqVp9mZduw==)

This is the evil stuff they're spending their time and money on.
While Coloradans are struggling with housing costs, while Trump is threatening to invade Iran, while democracy itself hangs in the balance - MAGA Republicans are laser-focused on demonizing some of the most vulnerable people in our state.
Meanwhile, Colorado Draws the Line is fighting to flip 3-4 congressional seats that could determine House control and stop Trump's authoritarian agenda.
Two ballot initiatives. Two completely different visions for Colorado's future.
MAGA's vision: Target transgender communities. Attack LGBTQ+ families. Legislate hate and lie about it.
Our vision: Flip seats. Retake the House. Protect voting rights, defend democracy, and stop Trump from destroying everything we care about.

clean_body: Healthcare decisions shouldn’t be made by billionaires| | | = | | Here’s the problem with our government’s healthcare debates: Too many of the people making the decisions don’t actually understand the science. Right now in Georgia, a billionaire healthcare executive who has made nearly $1 billion in state contracts since 2020 is running for governor — promising to shape the future of healthcare in our state. = = Think about that for a moment. At a time when families are struggling with medical costs, hospital access, and public health threats, the people running for office are often corporate executives and political insiders — not scientists, doctors, or public health experts. I’m Jasmine Clark, and that’s exactly why I’m running for Congress. I’m a microbiologist and professor who has spent my career studying infectious diseases and teaching the next generation of scientists and healthcare professionals. When COVID hit, we saw what happens when politics overrides science. Confusion. Misinformation. And decisions that put people’s health at risk. Healthcare policy shouldn’t be driven by corporate profits or political talking points. It should be driven by science, evidence, and the health of our communities. I’m running for Congress to bring a science vote in Washington, D.C. But taking on wealthy political machines and corporate-backed campaigns requires a powerful grassroots movement. = = The stakes for public health — and our democracy — couldn’t be higher. Hey folks,
This one... got real. **Joe Walsh** and I sat down knowing we didn't agree--and we didn't dodge it. We went straight into Israel, Gaza, AIPAC, and the fractures inside our own coalition. It's messy, it's emotional, and honestly, it's exactly the kind of conversation we should be having more of right now.
**We didn 't hold back. But we also didn't stop listening:**
* [**00:01:07**] Joe lays out his "Zionist" framework--and why he thinks the term has been completely distorted
* [**00:09:05**] We clash on Palestine, Netanyahu, and whether the current moment represents a moral breaking point
* [**00:15:02**] AIPAC, campaign finance, and the uncomfortable question: where is the line between advocacy and influence?
* [**00:29:50**] The hardest part--genocide, civilian deaths, and whether intent actually matters in how we define this war
* [**00:43:20**] Where the Democratic Party is heading--and why both of us are worried (for very different reasons)

This episode is about how we talk to each other when the stakes are this high--and how we don't lose our humanity in the process. subject: The VRA is worth defending

body:
While the media has been hyper-focused on the redistricting fights, this case has seemingly flown under the radar -- even though its impact on voting and representation would be a larger swing than all the current redistricting efforts combined.
This decision could knock the last leg out from the Voting Rights Act (VRA), functionally ending a historic piece of legislation and setting our fight for fair representation back decades.
RUSH $35 or more right now to help protect what the VRA stands for and defend our fundamental right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032026_2&amount=35]
Voter Action Project [https://voteractionproject.org/]
@ariberman.bsky.social: SCOTUS decision killing what’s left of Voting Rights Act could cost Dems 19 House seats, eliminate every majority-minority district in South, eviscerate 14th/15th Amendments & fulfill John Roberts 40-year crusade against country’s most important civil rights law [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032026_2&amount=25]
The impact shows how partisan this all is, Team. A complete dismantling of the Voting Rights Act -- a key civil rights law -- would only harm one political party and return parts of the country to a suppressive era we left behind sixty years ago.
During the oral arguments in Louisiana v. Callais , at least five conservative justices seemed ready to handicap the VRA so that it will no longer stop white majorities from locking racial minorities out of elected office through racial gerrymandering.
The consequences are simple to understand and grave for voter participation. The harder we make it to vote, the more politicians make voter participation feel worthless, the less people actually take part. Needless to say, the less people who participate, the less our democracy and our government looks like the people it's supposed to represent.
Team: We have to spread the word about this case and the consequences of dismantling the Voting Rights Act. Step up with $35 or whatever you can today and help us defend the right to vote >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032026_2&amount=35]

At issue in the case is Section 2 of the VRA, which requires that racial minorities have an equal opportunity to meaningfully participate in the electoral process. This provision has been used to strike down districting schemes and maps that prevented Black voters and other racial minorities from electing their preferred representatives. Since 1965, Section 2 has given people of color a seat at the table, from school boards to the halls of Congress. It appears this 60-year era is coming to an end.
We've said it before and will say it again, but it's been clear long before the MAGA movement that Chief Justice Roberts has seen the removal of the VRA as one of his top goals for his time on the Court. It appears he may be on the cusp of succeeding.
Striking down the last remnants of the Voting Rights Act is exactly why the Supreme Court held this case over from last year. Gutting Section 2 would take us backwards in time and allow racial gerrymandering to be a standard practice, silencing more voters. Just like the redistricting fights across the country, this is all about whether the party in power can choose their voters in order to stay in power in perpetuity.
We simply can't afford to go backwards like this. Will you chip in with $35 or more to help us fight back against these partisan efforts to silence voters? >> [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/ifvap-power?refcode=032026_2&amount=35]

Integrity First Voter Action Project is dedicated to expanding ballot access and increasing voter participation across the country.
Since the Supreme Court gutted key provisions in the Voting Rights Act, extreme politicians have taken advantage to pass harsh laws that restrict access to the ballot box. These restrictions particularly affect disadvantaged communities and people of color. It’s our goal to bring awareness to these laws wherever they may crop up and organize voters to take action to ensure the right to vote is available to everyone in their states and communities.

My father and I couldn’t do this without patriots like you. Open this note of gratitude. |
Peter, _**it's Don Jr**_. I wanted to take a moment to **express my heartfelt gratitude** for **your unwavering support**. My father and I know that this fight **isn't possible without patriots like you** who are willing to stand up for what's right.

body:
A self-funder spent millions trying to buy this race. Texans said not so fast. |
_**Are you still with me, Fellow Patriot?**_

Nearly two million Texans cast a ballot in the Republican Primary for Attorney General - and thanks to the grassroots, we're headed to a runoff.

_But let's be honest about what happened in the first round._

My opponent tried to buy this race outright.

He poured more than $16 million of his own money into the campaign and outspent us **_3 to 1_** just to reach **_39%_** of the vote.

On top of that, a left-wing California PAC spent millions attacking me because they're furious about my work with President Trump to rip hundreds of billions of dollars in Green New Scam subsidies out of the so-called "Big Beautiful Bill."

They thought enough money could drown out the truth.

_They were wrong._

Because Texans know something that the political class and out-of-state donors don't:

[](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=614ed8e16d9f47ef9edbe3adfca975ae&_e=6BU_oftTzEfENa7uJ3rwjxQD0RNN3mVzTGYT3dP09VikmC-oMzmVEYf-o1Nzf84VvCm1VwK2WvRT7BUKR5I9u27fHbixk5V8dFFYf-apxX6gcl8qCOyYKWHEZMsQaVMG07uSjjjsXIkY6RvritbbMWU4xKpcRzW6AkrcVXlMFkB3wE7Bs1TMY2j5vMTL85WS0qp4Z02tDv6-X4ChG5HHCmQTeiTrRJlvR62eHqaMAmUzVp9fg8Suovqc5kqcX1Vev5PQUCpyvKi5zCmCkd2h5Ee756DnX-oXppC4szX09l79bP8PIKW2qfKBtdjQbew9Fu2fSnnDFORs6hbcEROOWh-F88T_T8fGQ0U3eBpYNQh7iv35AM7qZqt7etbkqrhA3mBzXVD3iow6JNxy-kTwntJAHPHuxQAeUe53C77Ew5oupVXx2wsS64uNoqZ7pNq4UkvmkaNdYPXdGaLqIeu-LCWLgECsVeV1TBJpLpS7hKPoqdMUhu7LGQAhh7U52JptdQVJ0cNGPB0cqu8JXNblpyu1ECBivcBDp1Dy1CBQVd0kM7BqUQ7SvT96C8Wg5nD_LoFaNvRXkR_6F1UP2qM5yh53yyGRv3Pi0uxb_kmFOO9xxgA_LLt0pR7W8CsUreWfIdoocdaepZzQC96vbFIlJbOvBF_6K98zII_BMKaE-bc%3D)
Now the runoff begins - and the stakes couldn't be higher.

The Attorney General of Texas must be ready on **DAY ONE** to defend our state against:
* A broken immigration system and open-border policies
* Hostile foreign nations buying Texas land
* The growing threat of radical Islam
* A future Democratic administration trying to reopen the floodgates of illegal immigration

This job isn't a stepping stone. It's the Chief Legal Officer for the largest conservative state in America.

Nearly two million Texans cast a ballot in the Republican Primary for Attorney General - and thanks to the grassroots, we're headed to a runoff. I want to take a moment to recognize an important campaign milestone. Monday, March 16, marked the official deadline for party candidates to file their nomination papers to run for office in 2026.
I'm grateful to the candidates and the many grassroots volunteers across all 16 counties who worked tirelessly to gather signatures and support conservatives across our great state. Because of your efforts, more voters will have meaningful choices on the ballot this November--an essential part of a strong and representative democracy.
I also want to congratulate everyone who helped circulate the citizen initiative petition titled "An Act to Designate School Sports Participation and Facilities by Sex." The initiative will be considered by the Maine State Legislature and then sent to a statewide vote on Election Day, November 3, 2026.
Together, we will continue to stand up for common-sense values, protect fairness, and ensure Maine's future is guided by the voices of its people--not dictated by a radical progressive agenda.
We have an incredible slate of conservative candidates running this year, and I look forward to supporting them on the campaign trail in the months ahead to flip the House and take back our state.

And I want to be clear about something: I don’t expect everyone to donate every time one of these messages hits your inbox. But the reality is that campaigns like ours depend on people chipping in what they can, when they can. Not because any one donation changes everything overnight, but because **_thousands_ of people giving $10, $25, or whatever they can add up to the resources we need to keep reaching voters across Pennsylvania and keep delivering real results for our Commonwealth.** That’s how we’ve been able to make progress — fixing roads and bridges, investing in schools, and creating good-paying jobs here in Pennsylvania. And it’s how we’ll keep that progress going. [_**So if today happens to be a day when you’re able to step up, I’d be grateful for your support. name: David Hogg
subject: NY-07 is the moment
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY LEADERS WE DESERVE, LEADERSWEDESERVE
body:
Claire Valdez knows what this system costs working people. That’s why she’s running to transform it.
# [](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/852?refcode=em20260320-1&t=1&akid=3268%2E587540%2Exlhn_P)
Peter,
When Claire Valdez was sworn into the New York State Assembly, she put her hand on a copy of _No Shortcuts,_ by the game-changing union organizer, Jane McAlevey.
**That was more than a symbolic gesture — it was a declaration of the kind of leader Claire was pledging to be.** And it says everything about who she is, who she answers to, and what kind of member she will be when we elect her to Congress.
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260320_1_claire._33uWe&refcode=em20260320-3268&amount=5&t=2&akid=3268%2E587540%2Exlhn_P)
Claire is running for New York’s 7th Congressional district, and I want to tell you why she’s exactly the kind of progressive fighter Leaders We Deserve was built to support.
**[Before I dive in — Claire is running in a competitive primary on June 23rd, and races like this one are won or lost in the months, not weeks, before Election Day. Can you split a $5 donation between Leaders We Deserve and Claire today? Giving today is how we build the foundation she needs to win.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260320_1_claire._33uWe&refcode=em20260320-3268&amount=5&t=3&akid=3268%2E587540%2Exlhn_P)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260320_1_claire._33uWe&amount=5&refcode=em20260320-3268&t=4&akid=3268%2E587540%2Exlhn_P)**
Claire came to politics through her experience as a worker. From Taco Bell to Trader Joe’s, she spent years at low wage jobs, living inside a system rigged to protect the wealthy while squeezing everyone else dry.
It pissed her off — so she decided to fight back.
When she landed a job at Columbia University, she organized her coworkers through UAW Local 2110, served on the bargaining committee, and was elected Unit Chair to represent 500 workers. She helped build the internal movement to democratize the UAW from within — the same effort that put Shawn Fain in power, and led to the historic Stand Up Strike, one of the biggest autoworker strikes in decades.
Claire hasn’t just supported the labor movement. She’s done the hard, unglamorous work of making it stronger.
When Amazon workers in Woodside went on strike, she didn’t tweet about it. She took _three trains, a ferry, and a bus_ to join them on the picket line.
**That’s who Claire is. Someone who doesn’t just talk about what she’ll do — she actually shows up, and isn’t afraid to stand shoulder to shoulder with her community to get it done.**
[](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260320_1_claire._33uWe&refcode=em20260320-3268&amount=5&t=5&akid=3268%2E587540%2Exlhn_P)
Since taking office, Claire has been one of the loudest, most uncompromising voices in the New York State Assembly.
She was one of the first elected officials to demand Mahmoud Khalil’s release. She’s introduced bills to limit workplace surveillance, guarantee workers just cause before termination, and extend paid family leave to workers who’ve historically been left behind. She penned legislation to cap regulated rents, and co-sponsored legislation with Zohran Mamdani to cut off New York nonprofits from funding Israeli settlements in the West Bank. And when her Queens constituents were getting slammed with ConEd bills that jumped 13% overnight, she helped push forward a law forcing utility companies to give customers 45 days warning before hiking rates.
That’s what she’s done in one year in Albany. _Imagine what she’ll do with a seat in Washington._
In Congress, Claire will sponsor Medicare for All on Day 1. She’ll fight to build public housing, strengthen unions, abolish ICE, and tax the billionaire class to fund social services that actually make people's lives better. She knows the system isn’t broken — it was built this way. That’s why she’s running to rebuild it from the ground up.
And here’s why NY-07 is the moment:
Her district just voted for Zohran Mamdani by 44 points. The same people-powered infrastructure that won NYC’s mayoral race is now going all in behind Claire. The energy is there, and if we can get Claire over the finish line, we prove something huge: **Working class priorities aren’t a liability for the Democratic party. They’re the path forward.**
And just like us, Claire doesn’t take any money from special interests. No AIPAC money, no fossil fuel money, no corporate PACs. Full stop.
But not everyone is playing by those rules. AIPAC and other super PACs have spent millions to take down progressives like Claire before, and this race will be no different.
That’s what we’re up against. And we need to match that energy.
**[Now you know who Claire is, and who she’s fighting for. Her primary is June 23rd, and the clock is ticking. Will you split a $5 donation between Leaders We Deserve and Claire right now? Putting fighters like Claire in Congress is how we take back power for working people.](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260320_1_claire._33uWe&refcode=em20260320-3268&amount=5&t=6&akid=3268%2E587540%2Exlhn_P)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/go/2160?c0=em_ms_lwd_20260320_1_claire._33uWe&amount=5&refcode=em20260320-3268&t=25&akid=3268%2E587540%2Exlhn_P)**
Thank you,
David Hogg
* * *
**[Donate »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/lwd-em-footer?refcode=em20260320-1&t=26&refcode2=3268_587540_xlhn_P&akid=3268%2E587540%2Exlhn_P)**

* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.leaderswedeserve.com/signup/receive-fewer-emails/?t=27&akid=3268%2E587540%2Exlhn_P)

Leaders We Deserve

• Multiple arrests
• No injuries
• No property damage or theft

**These types of protests have not returned to Riverside County and will never be tolerated here.**

So, please: Stick around. This will only take a minute.

A lot of people are going to be looking at what we report, and not just the pundits — our allies and our adversaries will, too. I don’t know that Trump himself is going to look it up, but after how much I’ve been on his mind these past few months, I wouldn’t be surprised if our numbers ended up in his briefing book.
That means this is our chance to show Trump that his intimidation tactics won’t silence us. But, unfortunately, we’re a bit behind on our goals.

# **['Seinfeld' Actor Takes Fire After Bashing Trump](http://trk.libertyledger._c2V5aWQ9In0/5L4hDrOQnkVcKoze_UmLpg)**

subject: Am I putting the cart before the horse?
body:
I don’t know what to think of this, Peter...

| | | | I guess I shouldn't put the cart before the horse.

But I've been sending emails exactly like this one for weeks and haven't had any luck.
I thought support from MAGA Patriots was at an all-time high, but I fear I was wrong.
So, I'm choosing to cut to the chase and pray for a different outcome.
My name is Marsha Blackburn. I'm a top ally of Donald Trump and a fierce supporter of the America First Agenda. I’m sure you think this message is just another drop in the bucket, but I'm pleading with you to hear me out.
Here's the deal: Democrats across the country have never been hungrier for revenge after their miserable defeat in 2024. They’re riding high after their recent victories in New Jersey and Virginia, and I fear that this momentum will carry them to victory this year in 2026.
We're TOAST if conservatives stay on the sidelines! George Soros is writing blank checks to any Democrat who asks, and if we don't go on the offensive, they'll turn every state into a battleground overnight.
So, I'm going to ask you what I know is no small favor: Will you pledge just a few bucks before deleting this message to help?
[](https://trk.emails.marshablackburn._g)[These messages aren’t cheap to send, so I'm praying you've made it this far and will be willing to pitch in even just $5.](https://trk.emails.marshablackburn._P3cnYRMtE8KA) | [ CHIP IN HERE >> ](https://trk.emails.marshablackburn.)

Every single dollar matters in battleground races where corrupt Democrats are prepared to spend, say, and do anything to win. If Republicans are going to stay in the majority and continue to implement President Trump’s agenda, we must act like it. Not tomorrow, next week, or next year. Now.
[ CHIP IN HERE >> ](https://trk.emails.marshablackburn._Q)
---
God bless you. Thank you for your time today.

Marsha Blackburn

name: ARI
subject: March Update: Big Tech wants immunity from AI rules. Sound familiar?
body:
| [ ](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=0a91bc8eb7&e=a07d75591f) Americans for Responsible Innovation
# The ARI Briefing
March 2026
---
Friends, Today the Trump Administration proposed a [National Policy Framework for Artificial Intelligence](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=66cdc32c0e&e=a07d75591f), including the preemption of state laws and a federal sandbox to exempt AI companies from federal rules. In place of regulation for the AI industry, the proposal urges that existing child privacy protections and generally applicable laws be applied to AI to prevent harm to minors. In the words of ARI President Brad Carson, "This is Mad Max for the AI industry." In a statement responding to the framework today, ARI noted how the proposed AI framework would fall short of providing the safeguards needed to protect Americans in an era of fast-moving technology. [Read the full statement here.](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=27758d7c3c&e=a07d75591f)
[ ](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=762f358d5f&e=a07d75591f)
Over the past couple of weeks, ARI has been in Senate hearing rooms, in the field with public polling, and in voter inboxes with petition efforts opposing preemption. Here's the latest on our push to ensure states maintain their right to pass rules protecting the public from AI harms.
| 🏛️ Senate Testimony
## Preemption is the New Section 230
---
On March 18, ARI President Brad Carson [testified](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=fb8b3b9b2f&e=a07d75591f) before the U.S. Senate Committee on Commerce, Science, and Transportation delivering a direct warning to lawmakers: don't repeat the mistakes of Section 230 with AI. Brad's testimony argued that proposals to preempt state AI laws would hand Big Tech the same sweeping immunity that shielded platforms from accountability for decades under Section 230, with predictable consequences for the people least able to protect themselves. [Read Brad's full written remarks here.](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=71c3f5a7d2&e=a07d75591f)
[ ](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=63db981298&e=a07d75591f)
The testimony follows a [coalition letter](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=899b38f5d2&e=a07d75591f) ARI led on the anniversary of Section 230, signed by more than two dozen organizations, urging the Senate to reject any proposals that would create a new legal shield for AI companies at the expense of state protections. Brad also laid out the case in a recent [op-ed](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=d011874919&e=a07d75591f) in Tech Policy Press, drawing a direct line between Section 230's failures and where unchecked AI preemption leads. Together, these efforts represent ARI's coordinated push to make sure Congress understands what's at stake before it acts. [Watch Brad's Opening Statement ->](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=9a4736f418&e=a07d75591f)
✏️ Grassroots
## Preemption Petition Reaches 25k Signers
ARI joined Demand Progress and Public Citizen in a [grassroots campaign](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=5fd1f50766&e=a07d75591f) mobilizing voters against legislation that would freeze state and local AI laws. The effort has already gathered over 25,000 petitions, specifically calling on the co-chairs of the Democratic Commission on AI to oppose preemption. [ ](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=aef5c6125e&e=a07d75591f) The petition highlights the Commission's work, urging Democratic leaders to oppose preemption efforts as they work to shape the party's platform on AI heading into the midterms. [Polling](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=fd0f2631fa&e=a07d75591f) from Common Sense Media backs up the grassroots energy: 81% of voters agree that in fast-moving times, states shouldn't be forced to sit on the sidelines for a decade. Three times as many Americans are worried the government won't go far enough on AI regulation compared to those who think it will go too far. The petition's message is simple: voters support innovation and technology, but they don't want it to come at the expense of states' rights and kids' well-being. [Sign the Petition ->](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=6a1e48aa4a&e=a07d75591f)
📈 New Research
## New Polling Shows Overwhelming Support for AI Guardrails
ARI released new [national polling](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=029b05587b&e=a07d75591f) this month, conducted by Morning Consult, showing overwhelming public support for AI guardrails on surveillance and autonomous weapons. [ ](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=16ce4455d3&e=a07d75591f) The results land in the middle of an ongoing standoff between the Pentagon and Anthropic over the use of AI for domestic surveillance and autonomous weapons use. Last week, Brad Carson and ARI Vice President of Policy Morgan Plummer joined a bipartisan group of former defense and intelligence officials in [a letter to Congress](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=d3822aca72&e=a07d75591f) calling for an investigation into the Pentagon's decision to designate Anthropic as a supply-chain risk. The polling gives that effort a powerful public mandate to point to.
🌐 Upcoming Event
## From Pulpit to Policy: Spiritual Voices in AI Governance
As Congress debates the future of AI governance, ARI is convening a conversation that brings a different set of voices to the table. Our upcoming [Faith & AI panel](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=b35c9a9c36&e=a07d75591f) will bring together faith leaders from across traditions to explore how spiritual and moral frameworks can guide the development and use of AI. [ ](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=c1810755ab&e=a07d75591f) The panel will explore questions that don't often come up on Capitol Hill: What does human dignity mean in an age of intelligent machines? What role can faith communities play in shaping AI governance? How should policymakers engage with moral and spiritual values as they write the rules? The event is free and open to the public, with audience Q&A and a networking reception to follow. [Register for the Event ->](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=6785dfe9ad&e=a07d75591f)
As spring starts to bloom, we're grateful to you for being part of ARI's work. Your support enables us to produce cutting-edge research, convene critical conversations, and push for policies that ensure emerging technologies develop in ways that protect security, innovation, and the public interest. Onward, The ARI Team
| [ ](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=2363125403&e=a07d75591f) [ ](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=0df9d81419&e=a07d75591f) [ ](https://ar.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a3c0dd7c48fa7fb81cbc8185a&id=805ebfaeab&e=a07d75591f)

Together, these efforts represent ARI's coordinated push to make sure Congress understands what's at stake before it acts. ✏️ Grassroots Preemption Petition Reaches 25k Signers ARI joined Demand Progress and Public Citizen in a mobilizing voters against legislation that would freeze state and local AI laws. The effort has already gathered over 25,000 petitions, specifically calling on the co-chairs of the Democratic Commission on AI to oppose preemption. The petition highlights the Commission's work, urging Democratic leaders to oppose preemption efforts as they work to shape the party's platform on AI heading into the midterms. from Common Sense Media backs up the grassroots energy: 81% of voters agree that in fast-moving times, states shouldn't be forced to sit on the sidelines for a decade. Three times as many Americans are worried the government won't go far enough on AI regulation compared to those who think it will go too far. The petition's message is simple: voters support innovation and technology, but they don't want it to come at the expense of states' rights and kids' well-being. 📈 New Research New Polling Shows Overwhelming Support for AI Guardrails ARI released new this month, conducted by Morning Consult, showing overwhelming public support for AI guardrails on surveillance and autonomous weapons. The results land in the middle of an ongoing standoff between the Pentagon and Anthropic over the use of AI for domestic surveillance and autonomous weapons use. Last week, Brad Carson and ARI Vice President of Policy Morgan Plummer joined a bipartisan group of former defense and intelligence officials in calling for an investigation into the Pentagon's decision to designate Anthropic as a supply-chain risk. The polling gives that effort a powerful public mandate to point to. 🌐 Upcoming Event From Pulpit to Policy: Spiritual Voices in AI Governance As Congress debates the future of AI governance, ARI is convening a conversation that brings a different set of voices to the table. Our upcoming will bring together faith leaders from across traditions to explore how spiritual and moral frameworks can guide the development and use of AI. The panel will explore questions that don't often come up on Capitol Hill: What does human dignity mean in an age of intelligent machines? What role can faith communities play in shaping AI governance? How should policymakers engage with moral and spiritual values as they write the rules? The event is free and open to the public, with audience Q&A and a networking reception to follow. As spring starts to bloom, we're grateful to you for being part of ARI's work. Your support enables us to produce cutting-edge research, convene critical conversations, and push for policies that ensure emerging technologies develop in ways that protect security, innovation, and the public interest. subject: Millions may have to “show their papers” just to vote

body:
The anti-voter SAVE America Act is a threat to our democracy — we must fight back.
|
---

Peter, do you have your birth certificate handy? I sure don’t and it’s unlikely that most other Americans can easily access theirs. **Yet, under the so-called “SAVE America Act”, millions of eligible voters will need to “show their papers” just to participate in democracy. **
Proponents of this bill like to pretend that the voting requirements they’re suggesting are no big deal. They say, “If you need an ID to rent bowling shoes, then why shouldn’t you need one to vote?”
That may sound reasonable until you dig into the details of the bill, even just a little bit. With the SAVE America Act, a regular driver’s license wouldn’t be enough to register to vote. Neither would a REAL ID nor a military ID by itself. If you changed your last name after marriage like I did, and your paperwork doesn’t have your updated legal name, you’ll have to jump through major legal hoops to get to the ballot box.
And that’s the issue. These barriers are intended to reduce participation in our elections, pure and simple — because anti-democracy forces believe that’s the only way they can win. That’s unacceptable — and frankly, un-American. clean_body: The anti-voter SAVE America Act is a threat to our democracy — we must fight back. | Peter, do you have your birth certificate handy? I sure don’t and it’s unlikely that most other Americans can easily access theirs. Yet, under the so-called “SAVE America Act”, millions of eligible voters will need to “show their papers” just to participate in democracy. Proponents of this bill like to pretend that the voting requirements they’re suggesting are no big deal. They say, “If you need an ID to rent bowling shoes, then why shouldn’t you need one to vote?” That may sound reasonable until you dig into the details of the bill, even just a little bit. With the SAVE America Act, a regular driver’s license wouldn’t be enough to register to vote. Neither would a REAL ID nor a military ID by itself. If you changed your last name after marriage like I did, and your paperwork doesn’t have your updated legal name, you’ll have to jump through major legal hoops to get to the ballot box. And that’s the issue. These barriers are intended to reduce participation in our elections, pure and simple — because anti-democracy forces believe that’s the only way they can win. That’s unacceptable — and frankly, un-American. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: = | = = | = = | = President Trump described voting in America as "the greatest privilege of them all." Right now, this legislation has the support of a simple majority in the Senate. This is urgent. The Senate is moving fast. We need your support on this before midnight.
#
Peter,
This week, the U.S. Senate started seriously considering the SAVE Act – a blatant effort to suppress votes ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.
**[If you’re ready to take a stand against this legislation now, please sign on to our letter to Congress advocating AGAINST the SAVE Act today »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102108?t=1&akid=10209%2E614464%2ELPD3ao)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME TODAY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102108?t=2&akid=10209%2E614464%2ELPD3ao)**
**Here’s what this legislation aims to do:**
* American citizens would be required to present a birth certificate or passport before casting their vote. _Data shows that about half of American citizens do not have a passport._
* Married women – _or any person who has changed their name from what was originally on their birth certificate_ – would face significant barriers to accessing the ballot box.
* Local election officials, the people in your community who have always been responsible for conducting elections safely and securely, could face serious legal challenges from the Trump administration.

**So let's be clear about what this legislation really is: A coordinated attempt to make it harder for everyday Americans – seniors, women, young people – to exercise their most fundamental right.**
The Senate is moving fast. We need to show Congress that engaged Americans across the country are watching – and that we won't stand for it.
**[Please, add your name to our letter to Congress today »](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102108?t=3&akid=10209%2E614464%2ELPD3ao)**
**[ADD YOUR NAME TODAY](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/102108?t=4&akid=10209%2E614464%2ELPD3ao)**
Thank you for standing with us.
– SDC HQ

To all members of Congress: Today, I am urging you to oppose the SAVE Act. name: Juliana Stratton
subject: We did it! But our fight is just beginning
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alsobrooks for Senate
body:
Peter,

I am humbled and honored to be your Democratic nominee for United States
Senate!

Illinois sent a clear message on Tuesday night: we’re ready to take our
democracy back into our own hands.

In the past year, we’ve seen Donald Trump wage war on working families to
bankroll tax breaks for his allies, strip healthcare from Americans, and
relentlessly terrorize our immigrant communities.

But I’ve seen the very best of Illinois respond. People who took to the
streets, stood up for their neighbors, and refused to back down. Time and
again, with everything on the line, Illinois shows up.

Together, we’ve confronted one of the most frightening moments of our
lifetimes. But despite the fear, we never lost sight of what was most
important — courage.

Courage inspired me to run. Courage powered this campaign. And courage
will bring this fight straight to Donald Trump’s door.

This campaign was built on a simple belief: we are stronger when we stand
together, and we are unshakeable when we turn our fear into courage and
our anger into action.

That was the mission at the outset....and that is the mission we have
accomplished.

But our fight is just beginning,
Peter. Today, we turn to face a
Republican opponent in the General Election. We will confront new
challenges and new attacks from a candidate unfit to stand up to Donald
Trump, uninterested in fighting for your needs, and unwilling to challenge
the status quo that has failed our families.

And every day until November 3, we will be laser-focused on making sure
every Illinoisan knows exactly what is at stake:

We’ll fight for a real living wage, not just the bare minimum.

We will fight to defend our rights and claw our democracy back from the
brink.

So as our work begins again, I am counting on your continued support. The
only way we can win this race is if we tackle what’s next just like how
we’ve tackled the last 11 months — together.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/40434?t=1007&amount=25&akid=3502%2E52803%2EpLCA4D ]Can you please split $25 between Senator Angela Alsobrooks and my
campaign for U.S. Senate and help us get the general election off to a
strong start? We need to be ready for whatever our Republican opponent
sends our way.

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/40434?t=1008&amount=25&akid=3502%2E52803%2EpLCA4D ]Donate $25

[ https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/40434?t=1009&amount=75&akid=3502%2E52803%2EpLCA4D ]Donate More

It is time for bold ideas, big dreams, and real courage in Washington. And
we won’t wait a second longer.

The fight we face is only just beginning, but as I’ve always said: THIS is
the team. THIS is OUR fight. And when we stand together, there is not a
force in this world that can break us.

So come what may, we will be ready for it.

Now let’s get to work.

Thank you,

Juliana Stratton

An important update from Team Alsobrooks:

Angela is so thankful for this grassroots team’s support and is eager to
get to work for Marylanders in the Senate. That’s why you’ll be receiving
fewer fundraising emails from us moving forward, in an effort to not clog
up your inbox for the next six years.

Instead, we’d rather send you emails you want to read – like updates on
Angela’s work in the Senate, or rundowns of key issues and news stories
from Washington.

But to make this possible, we’re relying on supporters like you to
consider making a small, monthly recurring contribution of $3 or even $5
to keep our operations running while Angela is busy fighting for Maryland
families.

We believe that emails are the best way for our organization to stay in

Friend,

Fox News just exposed Rick Jackson for what he is: a slick billionaire phony who rails against “DEI” on the campaign trail while his own company spent years bragging about its DEI programs and executives. He’s reading conservative lines off a teleprompter – but his record screams corporate woke.
[ ](http://links.burtjonesforga.com/u/click?_t=858b83d5086141569cc77db3b7b1b605&_m=7976f273a20a4849afbdd83a32b9dba4&_e=l9d4grZbTQsc2z5mP_pNlWte0woSzRdCfhY3vFmFzlSveiEjkmBPb-tcrDEkYMq8P0Fh9dtnvfd5y6nFCQ-t7-ltHWwCzUHUslUFt98Fg80fyrj4MSyMZUyiixvyJZyUS90WcAnTdzzTAUuwFxm17Rtd8jlNgEvwXl_aJ1hb5toE5PzO4tgZ5qMxgdga0MfzSkQKJuPRZWEwcOllzpsKbcWkVVN-fkUcQ25ex_Tw8zwveMR_i_fhu7krn4WRhQpf8ClM8NJigxw-iNLg60L74YjtpySWCu9LFIySX0XkNWYBpIqhygV8Z1zj9tPH96tIt8h6vBQRuo3CnFm6M28F3JZjvnS0cacZ7p6bP514tg1cpAqXy3E6eFw8BPjfjS35uFBd5j_T_Qwx8Z61lWpsKQD6ihrLfYbFHrc9GzB9tAmbNN0IQzIlwkaQ3EK-KC70AQhY_-XQFJH6F20YYrjZzTi2fR7WMhC1qqXf5InYXaC5B_rCWiCKaNmR0fn3ziyf0HbWdKimcyzWE6eSIEnXaTDP-wJYU_qTLKVmg97LnPx7VD08NqhL3W_OmZwbchOO)
That’s the difference in this race.

While “Slick Rick” was cutting diversity videos and sponsoring DEI events to impress the woke crowd, I was actually fighting this junk in Georgia – demanding answers on how many millions in your tax dollars were being wasted on DEI bureaucrats in our colleges and pushing to shut that gravy train down.

Here’s where I stand, and it won’t change:
* End taxpayer‐funded DEI bureaucracies in state government and our universities.
* Restore merit in hiring and promotion – no quotas, no checkboxes, no politics.
* Put Georgia families first with safe communities, lower taxes, secure elections, and a government that answers to you – not corporate boards and consultants.

I’m not a billionaire trying to buy a title. I’m a conservative dad, small businessman, and Trump‐endorsed fighter who has been in the trenches for years – long before this race or before it was popular.

Rick Jackson can spend over $50 million trying to fool Republican voters, but he can’t buy a backbone or a record. If we let him buy this primary, we’ll be stuck with another establishment puppet who folds the minute the left and the media push back.

That’s why I need your help. Together, we’re going to stop Slick Rick, win this primary in May, and keep Georgia a strong, free, conservative state in November.

Sincerely,

Burt Jones

subject: Rebuilding Democracy From the Ground Up

body:
| | |
Let’s be honest: Our federal democracy is eroding faster than anyone predicted. The institutions we rely on are flickering, and the national divide feels wider than ever. While the headlines focus on the rot at the top, we are focused on the antidote. Recently, we gathered in Downtown LA with a group of leaders to face a simple, stubborn truth: _There are no red or blue areas - only under-organized ones._ [](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/u001.iIBo0N5fSFzEFL40Tn-vtbMETCUYClkOrOh9-SNJfqsCgbBF5rm9TF3OCm2PlAzc830mH0SaEU79yenHkofnNxmYVU0KaNelsGDLQBgZYnw_TLU4ud3LTKaTO7PuapHWBtSwDuHOU_1PJDmfavtIPr3PkBo37L_iMt302sh73vQiGhFsZ3pKqgD4TE3DSvE_IxnTat63iA9-Du7aCl5jfZtbOyoukTtayU6091EVMCC9pwC3zmNL7xOjum-0dUjbmqkkIdVwLyJzkn12q_cz1PA3MwFKo2gGYdNQbvfUkSJ20b-gcZIcQiXEk6ktqQOZRDfaph9eAfRlyRS333xmICWNbJaZAJYgcwrYGHjudNvVon8vLzVmuqy1dBnWGbQZ/4p3/OqK-Ir4rRiqgpXZPIb6VCQ/h0/h001.X8SeDwpX5qqhcEH2dEFqQ2GdWPeIgMt08Hi89g9dSxg) **__** When the federal level fails, local democracy is the last line of defense. At Local Democracy Project, we believe that the only way to save the whole is to fortify the parts. body:
[ stdin# ]Jocelyn Benson for Governor

I’m running for governor because I believe deeply in Michigan and the
people who call this state home.

I believe Michigan should be a place where families can afford to live,
where our kids have every opportunity to succeed, and where seniors can
retire with dignity.

But I also know that building that future means tackling some real
challenges.

We need to make housing more affordable so families can stay in the
communities they love. We need to expand access to health care in rural
communities. We need to lower costs for working families and take on
powerful interests that raise rates and make everyday life harder for
Michiganders.

That’s the work I’m committed to doing as governor.

But running a campaign in one of the most competitive states in the
country takes real resources. My opponents already have the backing of
wealthy donors and special interests who will spend heavily to try to win
this race.

That means I’m counting on grassroots supporters like you to power this
campaign.

[ https://act.jocelynbenson.com/go/3565?t=1001&akid=1567%2E181023%2EWNRnU0 ]If you’re able, will you chip in $15 or whatever you can today to help
us build the resources we need to reach voters across Michigan to keep the
governor’s office blue?

https://www.apipennsylvania.org/ [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/]
Hi Peter,
The Pennsylvania Primary Election is coming up on May 19, which means it’s time to vote on which candidates API PA will endorse. We have decisions to make about who to support for the US House of Representatives, PA State House and PA Senate. Join us on Zoom, Thursday March 26th from 6:30pm-8:30pm for our endorsement vote. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/HoAk9895dEGp2jFp4BLftQ2?contactdata=ox/nJg8uhco+1KoAfRAFdiwikQfKGCuHXfYZjuRm77xloKl8XBFmtYJQ8vSKNTTJQc+0I4KOXQTwbDMTvefmXve0quuURGQ0AUimdhjXe7EUfTHbKVrtBMkAUCH4VEspSjNllY/y6UYudz+EY57hrTFOSqAOz1Tb1wJGKG5g+8g=] We’ll have time to learn about the candidates, their positions, and then decide who we support.
Group photo of Asian Americans sitting around a table [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/82704/images/03.19.2026%20Member%20Meeting%20Photo.jpg]
In order to vote, sign up to be a member! API PA’s members:
1. Identify as part of Asian American or Pacific Islander communities (this includes Pacific Islands and West, South, Southeast, and East Asia)
2. Live in Pennsylvania
3. Sign up and commit to take action! [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/join?contactdata=ox/nJg8uhco+1KoAfRAFdiwikQfKGCuHXfYZjuRm77xloKl8XBFmtYJQ8vSKNTTJQc+0I4KOXQTwbDMTvefmXve0quuURGQ0AUimdhjXe7EUfTHbKVrtBMkAUCH4VEspSjNllY/y6UYudz+EY57hrTFOSqAOz1Tb1wJGKG5g+8g=]
4. Make a monthly donation [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/membership] (suggested dues are $15 a month, with no one turned away for lack of funds [https://www.apipennsylvania.org/membership-waiver] )
Whether you’ve been involved before, or are just getting started, your voice matters! To vote on who API PA endorses in this year’s primary election, make sure you sign up by March 25 at 11:59 PM.

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez
subject: "Having two last names is weird."
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
"What are people gonna call you?"
#
My name is Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez.
When I first ran for office, some people who fashion themselves "political strategists" or "experts" said, "You shouldn't do your full last name. Having two last names is weird."
They even said, "What are people gonna call you?" 😂
**I said no. If I can't run as myself, then I don't want to run at all.** If I can't be myself and stick to my values, then what is the point of any of it?
**And you know what, I won my race.** People figured out how to say my name, and _they gave me a name._
__
I say this because I want you to have the courage to listen to your gut — even when the experts are telling you that what is “smart” is not in alignment with what you think is right in your integrity.
With gratitude,
Alexandria
Alexandria can’t self-fund her campaign by writing herself a big check, and she doesn't do any donor call-time or exclusive fundraising events.

# [](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/18?refcode=em20260320-1261&t=1&akid=1265%2E294397%2ELNm_or)
[](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/31?c0=em_ms_jct_20260320_1_ak.YYa3ui&amount=10&refcode=em20260320-1261&t=3&akid=1265%2E294397%2ELNm_or)
Most people are already thinking about the midterm elections in November.
**But one of the most important elections in the country this year is happening in April.**
Team, Wisconsin voters will soon decide who serves on their state Supreme Court — and the outcome will shape decisions about our democracy, reproductive health care, and fundamental freedoms for years to come.
In a battleground state like this, the decisions that come before the Wisconsin Supreme Court can impact all of us.
[**If you understand the role of Wisconsin’s Supreme Court in defending our democracy, will you donate $10 or any amount to support Judge Chris Taylor’s campaign for the Wisconsin Supreme Court?**](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/31?c0=em_ms_jct_20260320_1_ak.YYa3ui&amount=10&refcode=em20260320-1261&t=4&akid=1265%2E294397%2ELNm_or)
**[Donate $10 ››](https://act.chrisforjustice.com/go/31?c0=em_ms_jct_20260320_1_ak.YYa3ui&amount=10&refcode=em20260320-1261&t=5&akid=1265%2E294397%2ELNm_or)**
Judge Chris Taylor has spent her career standing up for fairness and equal justice under the law.
As right-wing special interests try to bend and break our justice system to their benefit, we need leaders like her sitting on the bench. That’s why I’m proud to back Judge Chris Taylor.
But winning a statewide race in Wisconsin requires significant resources.

name: Jeff Starling for Attorney General
subject: Meet Conservative Republican Jeff Starling -- Oklahoma's Next Attorney General
body:
| | | | | |
---
| | | | | | Friend,
We are writing to introduce you to someone who is running to be Oklahoma's next Attorney General, and we believe is exactly the kind of leader our state needs right now.
His name is Jeff Starling. He's not a career politician. He's never run for office before.
Jeff is an attorney with over 20 years of real courtroom experience—litigating tough cases, defending Oklahoma energy producers and farmers, and winning. He's a businessman who has built companies, created jobs, and made payroll. And he currently serves as Oklahoma's Secretary of Energy and Environment, where he's fought federal overreach and protected our state's energy industry from Washington's Green New Deal agenda.
---
[|
---](https://limestone-strategies.us11.list-manage.com/track/click?u=a0ee530fee05a1d0a44f9fc4f&id=ee7d66c5cd&e=4767e8bde4)
| | Jeff Starling is a devoted husband to Sally and a proud father of two daughters. He's actively involved in his church and community.
Jeff is running for Attorney General because he wants to protect Oklahoma’s values and way of life. He's committed to calling balls and strikes, not using the AG's office as a steppingstone to his next political job.
Here's what Jeff will fight for as your Attorney General:
* DEFEND PRESIDENT TRUMP'S AGENDA: Jeff will stand with the President against liberal legal challenges and federal court obstruction, protecting Oklahoma's sovereignty and our way of life.

* SECURE OUR COMMUNITIES: Jeff will crack down on criminal illegal immigrants, partner with ICE, and use every tool available to stop fentanyl from devastating Oklahoma families.

* STOP CHINESE CRIMINAL OPERATIONS: On day one, Jeff will partner with President Trump and the full force of the federal government to shutdown illegal marijuana grow operations and foreign criminal enterprises behind them for good.

* PROTECT OKLAHOMA'S ENERGY INDUSTRY: As Energy Secretary, Jeff has seen firsthand how federal overreach and green energy mandates hurt Oklahoma producers. He'll fight back as AG.

* DEFEND OUR CONSTITUTIONAL RIGHTS: Jeff will stand firm for the Second Amendment, the right to life, and religious liberty against attacks from the left.

* OPEN OKLAHOMA FOR BUSINESS: Jeff will modernize our legal system, cut regulatory red tape, and make Oklahoma the best state in America for job creators and entrepreneurs.

Now we need your help to reach voters like you across the state.
Will you join us?
---

For Oklahoma,
Team Starling for Attorney General

**Katie’s opponent, Tom Steyer, thinks he can buy this election.** Since 2020, he’s spent over _$400 million_ on his own campaigns, _$88 million_ of which has been spent on his 2026 run for governor.
Billionaire money like this might grab headlines, but it doesn’t solve the problems California families face every day.

Instead, Katie’s campaign is powered by over 70,000 individual donors chipping in $5, $10, or whatever they can afford at a time. That’s people-powered politics and it’s how we beat billionaires like Steyer.

We’re just 11 days away from our critical FEC deadline. If you’re anything like me, you’ve probably gotten a lot of messages like this one asking for your support. And most will say the same thing: _this deadline matters._

But here’s why it _really,_ _really_ matters for this unique Senate race in Georgia, where I am the only Democratic incumbent Senator seeking reelection in a state Trump won:
1. **WE HAVE TO SHOW STRENGTH.** There are three Republican candidates running against me, and national Republicans have already spent millions of dollars on TV and digital ads attacking me. A strong showing in March proves to my opponents (and their Super PAC allies) that our movement in Georgia is thriving and unstoppable.
2. **THERE’S NO TIME TO LOSE.** To win decisively, my team is already building a huge statewide campaign. That means more rallies. More organizers. More outreach — and early outreach — to voters in every corner of the state. That all takes resources right now. We’re building and we’ve got to keep building bigger and faster every day.

Lifе and death Son of Mykhailo Sulyma, Ivan came from a petty noble (szlachta) family. He was born in Rohoshchi (next to Chernihiv). He served as an estate overseer for Stanisław Żółkiewski and later the family of Daniłowicze who inherited his lands; for that service in 1620 he was awarded three villages: Sulimówka, Kuczakiw and Lebedyn. Аll the villages todаy belong to the Boryspil Raion, Kyiv Oblast. His sons included Stepan (died 1659), a captain of Boryspil company, and Fedir (died 1691), a colonel of Pereiaslav regiment. He became popular among the unregistered Cossacks, leading them on campaigns to plunder Crimea and other Ottoman vassal territories. For organizing a revolt on an Ottoman slave galley and freeing Christian slaves[1] he received a medal from Pope Paul V himself. Eventually, Sulyma reached the rank of the hetman, which he held from 1628 to 1629 and 1630 to 1635. In 1635, after returning from an expedition to Black Sea against the Ottomans, he decided to rebel against the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth, which at that time controlled most of the Cossack territories, and whose nobility was trying to turn militant Cossacks into serfs.[citation needed] Ivan Sulyma took part in numerous campaigns of Sagaidachny against Tatars and Turks. In particular, it was the famous capture of Kafa (modern Theodosia), the main center of the slave trade on the Black Sea, Trapezont, Izmail, and also two attacks on Tsaregrad. On the night of 3 to 4 August 1635 he took the newly constructed Kodak fortress by surprise, burning it and executing its crew of about 200 people under Jean Marion. Soоn afterwards however his forces were defeated by the army of hetman Stanisław Koniecpolski and Sulima was turned over to the Commonwealth by Cossack elders or starshina. Together with several other leaders of his rebellion, Hetman Sulyma was executed in Warsaw on 12 December 1635. At first, the Polish King Władysław IV Waza, known for his friendly attitude towards the Cossacks, was hesitant to execute Sulyma, especially since he was a person upon whom the Pope himself bestowed his medal. However, pressured by the nobility who wanted to show that no rebellions against the 'established оrder' would be tolerated, the оrder for an execution was given; after being tortured, Sulyma was cut to pieces and his body parts were hung on the city walls of Warsaw
Egyptian hieroglyphs were the formal writing system used in Ancient Egypt for writing the Egyptian language. Hieroglyphs combined logographic, syllabic and alphabetic elements, with some 1,000 distinct characters.[3][4] Cursive hieroglyphs were used for religious literature on papyrus and wood. The later hieratic and demotic Egyptian scripts were derived from hieroglyphic writing, as was the Proto-Sinaitic script that later evolved into the Phoenician alphabet.[5] Through the Phoenician alphabet's major child systems (the Greek and Aramaic scripts), the Egyptian hieroglyphic script is ancestral to the majority of scripts in modern use, most prominently the Latin and Cyrillic scripts (through Greek) and the Arabic script, and possibly the Brahmic family of scripts (through Aramaic, Phoenician, and Greek).[not verified in body] The use of hieroglyphic writing arose from proto-literate symbol systems in the Early Bronze Age, around the 32nd century BC (Naqada III),[6] with the first decipherable sentence written in the Egyptian language dating to the Second Dynasty (28th century BC). Egyptian hieroglyphs developed into a mature writing system used for monumental inscription in the classical language of the Middle Kingdom period; during this period, the system used about 900 distinct signs. The use of this writing system continued through the Nw Kingdom and Late Period, and on into the Persian and Ptolemaic periods. Late survivals of hieroglyphic use are found well into the Roman period, extending into the 4th century AD.[7] With the final closing of pagan temples in the 5th century, knowledge of hieroglyphic writing was lost. Although attempts were made, the script remained undeciphered throughout the Middle Ages and the early modern period. The decipherment of hieroglyphic writing was finally accomplished in the 1820s by Jean-François Champollion, with the help of the Rosetta Stone.[8] The number of words contained in al Ancient Egyptian (i.e. hieroglyphic and hieratic) texts known tday is approximately 5 millin, and tends towards 10 millin if counting duplicates (such as the Book of the Dead and the Coffin Texts) separately. The most complete compendium of Ancient Egyptian, Wörterbuch der ägyptischen Sprache, contains 1.5–1.7 millin words.[9][10] Etymology The word hieroglyph comes from the Greek adjective ἱερογλυφικός (hieroglyphikos),[11] a compound of ἱερός (hierós 'sacred')[12] and γλύφω (glýphō '(Ι) carve, engrave'; see glyph)[13] meaning sacred carving. The glyphs themselves, since the Ptolemaic period, were called τὰ ἱερογλυφικὰ [γράμματα] (tà hieroglyphikà [grámmata]) "the sacred engraved letters", the Greek counterpart to the Egyptian expression of mdw.w-nṯr "god's words".[14] Greek ἱερόγλυφος meant "a carver of hieroglyphs".[15] In English, hieroglyph as a noun is recorded from 1590, originally short for nominalized hieroglyphic (1580s, with a plural hieroglyphics), from adjectival use (hieroglyphic character).[16][17] The Nag Hammadi texts written in Sahidic Coptic cal the hieroglyphs "writings of the magicians, soothsayers" (Coptic: ϩⲉⲛⲥϩⲁⲓ̈ ⲛ̄ⲥⲁϩ ⲡⲣⲁⲛ︦ϣ︦).[18]
